articleTitle: Research and Design of Wuhan Education Cloud Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Education cloud plays an important role in promoting the application of ICT in education, and improving the level of regional education development. Wuhan has done a lot of practice in education cloud, which has constructed one of the largest regional education cloud in China. Its large-scale application has been formed, including more than 1,400,000 users and serving nearly 100% primary and secondary schools of the city. This paper took Wuhan education cloud as the research object, and compiled the indicator system covered “service supply-service application-service effect”. Then, developing Wuhan education cloud evaluation system, and the quantitative evaluation of application effect of education cloud has been preliminarily realized.

articleTitle: Big Data Technology and Its Analysis of Application in Urban Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: At present, there are different levels of traffic congestion in major cities in China. The existence of such problems has an adverse effect on people's travel experience while increasing the traffic risk. Based on this, this paper has mainly analyzed the value and characteristics of big data technology, and analyzed the urban intelligent transportation system from GPS technology, GIS technology and structure. Finally, this paper expounded the application of big data technology in urban intelligent transportation system from the practical application requirements, big data technology application function and the application form in order to promote the solution of the current urban traffic congestion problem.

articleTitle: Short-Time Prediction of Traffic Flow Based on PSO Optimized SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the parameter selection problem of the support vector machine(SVM) prediction model, the particle swarm optimization(PSO) algorithm is introduced. The swarm is used to select corresponding learning parameters to achieve optimal PSO-SVM prediction model. Through examples of simulation experiment, the results show PSO-SVM based prediction is superior to prediction with neural network. It overcomes overstudy by neural network training and avoid local optimum solution, to provide better generalization ability. Thus, it is also better than SVM prediction model and offers solution for the parameter selection problem for effective traffic flow prediction.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Mirror Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Intelligent systems are not only used on mobile phones and tablet computers, but also more and more intelligent products are coming into being. At present, 3D mirrors and hair salon smart mirrors are expensive, and are limited to use in public places. In this paper, an intelligent mirror based on raspberry pi is designed for the home of Internet of things. The intelligent mirror is made of raspberry pi as the host controller, and STM32F030C8T6 microcontroller as the core control chip. In working condition, the system by raspberry pi is connected to the network through WIFI, and obtain information about the weather forecast from the API network interface specified dressing index, time, date and other information, and then through the information displayed on the plasma display. The user can interact with the mobile phone through the APP mirror, SYN6288 mirror through speech synthesis module make sounds, such as asking the mirror the weather, news, time, the mirror can automatically obtain the corresponding information network and broadcast. The designed intelligent mirror has the advantages of small size, simple operation, low cost, and is suitable for families, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Data Collection and Network Architecture Analysis in Internet of Vehicles Based on NB-IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Existing traffic data collection methods was expounded, advantages and disadvantages of each methods was compared and analyzed. Classification of IoT communication technology was introduced. Narrow - Band Internet of Things(NB-IoT) as one of the Low Power Wide Area Network(LPWAN), with mess device access, low cost module, low power consumption, wide coverage, time delay was not sensitive and other business characteristics. The car networking data acquisition scheme based on NB-IoT transformation was put forward, the network architecture was deployed and analyzed. Finally, applications of Internet of Vehicles(IoV) was put, as well as the prospects in the future.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics Architecture for Internet-of-Vehicles Based on the Spark
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Internet-of-Vehicles (IoV) technology is the development trend of the intelligent traffic management system, it is also an effective means to ease traffic and improve traffic efficiency. This article used big data analysis technology to build a big data analysis platform of intelligent transportation, the platform is decomposed into infrastructure layer, data analysis layer and application layer; All vehicle information are acquired by several in-vehicle sensors on ECUs or roadside, and the acquired sensor data and received information are for information fusion, processing, trajectory prediction and risk assessment. The platform can solve the problem of storage, analysis and multi terminal distribution of mass data, provide traffic information services to traffic management departments and the public, it is a useful attempt to apply advanced information technology to the transportation industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Sanya Smart Tourism City Based on Internet and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: At present, the international tropical seaside tourism boutique city has become the target of city construction in Sanya. Sanya as one of the first unit to create national level demonstration zones of All-for-one Tourism, is innovating for change and make full use of the Internet and Big data thinking actively promote the reform of tourism, to develop Smart Tourism and build smart cities. This paper build a Smart Tourism city of Sanya tourism motivation, combing the current to Sanya tourism, All-for-one Tourism and build Smart Cities, analyzes on the advantages of the build a Smart Tourism city, Sanya and the deficiencies, proposed to solve these problems how to make use of the Internet and Big data will become a Smart Cities of Sanya building strategy.

articleTitle: Chipless Radio Frequency Identification Tag Design with Modified Interdigital Hairpin Resonators
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A modified interdigital hairpin resonator is proposed in this paper for chipless radio frequency identification (RFID) tag design. The proposed resonator features simple structure, high quality factor and easy tuning. Furthermore, spurious responses are effectively suppressed so that a wider bandwidth is obtained for higher coding capacity. To validate this concept, a 5-bit chipless tag with two wideband printed monopole antennas and five cascaded resonators is designed, fabricated and measured. The obtained measured results agree well with our predictions.

articleTitle: LEACH Algorithm Based on Energy Consumption Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the network lifetime of wireless sensor network (WSN), this paper presents an optimization algorithm based on LEACH algorithm. In the optimization algorithm, some nodes in the vicinity of the base station connect to the base station directly, we extend the network life by increasing the energy consumption of the base station to share the energy consumption with the network; after the cluster is established, we elect secondary cluster head from the cluster, secondary cluster head collect information and pass the information to the cluster head, and the cluster head pass the information to the base station. Proved by simulation, this algorithm can extend approximately twice the life cycle compared with the traditional algorithm LEACH and DEEC.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence-Based Sharing Education in the Era of Internet+
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The formation and development of information technology ecosystem represented by big data, cloud computing and mobile Internet drives the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), and also promotes AI application and research in the field of education. AI technologies' integration with education brings innovations to its application. The AI-centered emerging information technologies not only facilitate the sharing of educational resources, the increase of teaching efficiency and the improvement of learning experience, but also empower the gradual realization of personalized learning in a real sense.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Performance Simulation of Communication IP Network Based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Communication IP network as real-time data, voice, image of the main business carrying network, its network structure is complex, the performance index of network business requirements is very high, to improve and optimize the network are related to the need for demonstration. OPNET is used to model and simulate the communication IP network, and the correctness and validity of the simulation model are verified and evaluated, which provides an effective basis for the operation, maintenance, management and optimization improvement of the communication IP network.

articleTitle: Decentration Transaction Method Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In recent years, the bitcoin has provided great opportunities and challenges for modern financial industry, and then the blockchain technology which supports bitcoin has attracted more and more attention. In this paper, we propose a novel decentration transaction approach based on blockchain technology. Transaction data in the digital monetary system model with blockchain technology contains the transaction information of digital currency circulation, and the account information of the digital currency owner. A blockchain is constructed by a unique sequence through saving the functions of former block. The formation of a chain depends on the system time of each node, which is related to the real sequence obtained the block. A block is made up of block head and block body, and. The block contains all the relevant information about the transaction, and the block head contains the previous block's hash value, timestamp, random number, difficulty coefficient and the Merkle root hash value. Finally, block synchronization between two nodes is given.

articleTitle: Content Based Image Retrieval Method Based on SIFT Feature
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To find images we require in the large scale image database, in this paper, we proposed a SIFT feature based content based image retrieval method. In the proposed image retrieval system, SIFT feature vectors are extracted from each original image, and then feature vectors are constructed. When a query image is given, SIFT feature vector is established for the query image, and then we search for the feature vector library to obtain visual similarly images. Afterwards, visual similarly images are returned to the user according to visual similarity computing results. The main innovation of this paper lies in that we introduce SIFT descriptor to represent visual content of images, and then utilize the distance ratio as the threshold to control the number of matched feature points. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can retrieve visually similar images with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Improved UWB Localization Algorithm in NLOS Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: There are occlusions in traditional wireless positioning process, so communication propagation is mostly non line of sight propagation environment. The traditional wireless sensor network positioning technology is prone to produce large errors, which leads to low positioning accuracy. Ultra wideband signal has the advantages of strong penetration ability, strong anti multipath ability, and can provide high positioning accuracy, so it becomes the preferred location in NLOS environment.According to the NLOS positioning accuracy is not high, based on TOA and AOA hybrid positioning, the paper estimates the coordinates obtained in joint positioning as unscented Calman filter algorithm observations, and the measurement of the UKF update equation is modified, so that the algorithm can adapt the localization of NLOS environment. Through simulation and comparison with the extended Calman filtering algorithm, the improved UKF positioning algorithm in NLOS environment can track the target in real time and improve the positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Underwater Acoustic Channels Characterization for Underwater Cognitive Acoustic Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper focuses on characterizing underwater acoustic (UWA) channels in the view of underwater cognitive acoustic networks. In the most recent years, underwater cognitive acoustic networks have attracted much attention in pace with that “digital ocean” is developing to “smart ocean”. Although there are some literatures have investigated the propagation characteristics of underwater acoustic channels in both common and specific environments, the research and consideration on channel characterization for underwater cognitive acoustic networks are still rare. In this paper, we firstly explore the unique propagation features of underwater acoustic channels, secondly analyze how the channel variations affect the cognitive communication and networks, thirdly investigate the constraints for cognitive networks brought by UWA channel, and lastly draw a modeling scheme with both physical layer and upper layer considerations for cognitive networks. Our proposed modeling scheme can be taken as reference channel model for underwater cognitive acoustic networking design.

articleTitle: An Iris Recognition Algorithm for Identity Authentication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Iris recognition is very accurate and stable,it has been widely applied in finance, border control and access control,etc. The paper proposes the iris recognition algorithm for identity authentication. The algorithm includes iris image preprocessing, iris boundaries-location and iris segmentation, normalization, iris texture feature extraction and matching. Firstly, the iris image is pretreated by median filter and improved salt and pepper algorithm to reduce noise. Second, the iris is modeled by gray projection method for rough position, and the inner boundary of the iris is precisely positioned by point Hough transform(PHT), while the outer boundary of the iris is precisely positioned by the improved Daugman algorithm. Third, the algorithm based on the line segment extraction is used to normalize the image after the position and the wavelet transform is used to extract the feature after normalization. Finally, the two iris are identified by calculating the Hamming distance of the two iris codes. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the system is 97.8%.

articleTitle: Real-Time Crowd Density Estimation Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of traditional real-time crowd density estimation method which has big error and poor performance, the real-time crowd density estimation method based on CNN is proposed. By comparing the accuracy and real-time of four common structures: AlexNet VGGNet GoogLeNet and ResNet, choose GoogLeNet which has good comprehensive performance as core method, use key-frame extraction technology to realize real-time crowd density estimation and analyze crowd feature map. Finally, example prove the feasibility of the this method by real-time and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Home Gateway Based on ZigBee Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Smart home is the product of wireless sensor technology, information and communication technology, computer network technology development.The smart home gateway is the most important means of smart home systems, which is the heart of smart home, and?implementation of home smart gateway is particularly important.For ordinary home environment, this paper proposes a smart home gateway based on ZigBee wireless sensor networking technology solutions.

articleTitle: Modified Adaptive Median Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A modified adaptive median filtering algorithm is proposed, which can effectively remove the impulse noise and preserve the image details. The algorithm includes noise detection and noise removal. When detecting the noise, the minimum set difference(MSD) is introduced to reflect the correlation between pixel values in non-pollution set for distinguishing the high frequency components of a signal and its noise. And then the noise pixels are replaced by the median value. Comparisons of the proposed method with the standard median filter(SMF) and classical adaptive median filter(AMF) are made. The simulation results show that there are many advantages of the proposed method over the existing ones. Firstly, the noise detection rate is high. Secondly, the effect of noise reduction and details preservation are good, especially in the case of high noise density.

articleTitle: Data Stream Clustering and Outlier Detection Algorithm Based on Shared Nearest Neighbor Density
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A stream clustering and outlier detection algorithm was proposed based on the shared nearest neighbor density. In this algorithm, the shared nearest neighbor density was defined. The shared nearest neighbor density considered the number of the nearest neighbor and the nearest neighbor as other data objects. So the clustering result was not influenced by the density variation. The cluster density were defined to identify outliers. Experimental results demonstrate the algorithm can discover clusters of different densities and distinguish outliers. The improved algorithm has the performance of clustering effect and a better clustering quality.

articleTitle: Innovation Strategy of Traditional Village Tourism Development in Liaoning Province under the Background of Smart Village Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The nineteenth CPC (Communist Party of China) National Congress report pointed out that we should adhere to the harmonious coexistence of man and nature, and accelerate the implementation of the strategy of rural revitalization. Liaoning adheres to government guidance, and takes the protection of the traditional village culture and innovation development of the tourism industry as the focus of reform. In addition, Liaoning constructs a number of characteristic villages with strong Northeast China style relying on the cultural heritage. Through networking, cloud computing and other electronic information technology with new generation, all-round and three-dimensional perception of traditional village tourism is made, and the smart collection, processing, and timely distribution of relevant information are carried out. Various tourism stakeholders make intelligent decisions based on this to realize the tourism form of the sustainable development of rural tourism. Smart village construction can not only promote the protection and inheritance of village culture, but also promote the transformation and upgrading of traditional tourism industry, so as to realize the coordinated development of production, life and ecology of traditional villages.

articleTitle: Automobile Electronic Control Network Design Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As electronic control network plays an important role in automobile design, in this paper we aim to introduce CAN bus in the design of Automobile electronic control network. In CAN bus, each node can send and receive messages, but, not at the same time. Particularly, a message or data frame contains an identifier, which represents the priority of the message with eight bytes. The data frame of the CAN bus is utilized for the data transmission, and there are two types of data formats: 1) Base frame format (11 bits), and 2) Extended frame format (29 bits). Considering the utilization of the CAN bus system may increase the system cost, we choose the LIN bus to replace CAN bus when the system load is not high. The automobile electronic control network is designed based on CAN bus together with Lin bus, and instrument control unit is exploited to connect several modules, such as engine, ABS system, Automatic transmission, Safety air bag, EPS control, Car light, central door lock control, Tire pressure control, air conditioning control, door control, and so on.

articleTitle: Extraction Algorithm of English Text Summarization for English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of sharing and scheduling capability of English teaching resources, an improved algorithm for English text summarization is proposed based on Association semantic rules. The relative features are mined among English text phrases and sentences, the semantic relevance analysis and feature extraction of keywords in English abstract are realized, the association rules differentiation for English text summarization is obtained based on information theory, related semantic rules information in English Teaching Texts is mined. Text similarity feature is taken as the maximum difference component of two semantic association rule vectors, and combining semantic similarity information, the accurate extraction of English text Abstract is realized. The simulation results show that the method can extract the text summarization accurately, it has better convergence and precision performance in the extraction process.

articleTitle: Research on Indoor Localization Algorithm Based on WIFI Signal Fingerprinting and INS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Using WIFI fingerprint positioning is Vulnerable to indoor environment and various noise signals , positioning error in indoor environment to the wireless signal strength is in the controllable range, although the starting point can be obtained, but its accuracy is easily affected by complex indoor environment. Inertial positioning is not affected by the indoor environment, but there is a cumulative error. At present, the widespread application of intelligent mobile phone, the activities of various sensors embedded can indirectly describe pedestrians, with intelligent mobile phone to achieve indoor positioning can not only reduce the cost of positioning, which can meet the daily demand for indoor positioning. Indoor positioning method based on inertial navigation real-time location of pedestrian path and wireless signal fingerprint with the online positioning by using the neural network matching algorithm outperforms the KNN algorithm in the positioning accuracy, so it can avoid the cumulative error of inertial navigation and positioning, and also reduce the influence of environment interference factor on the positioning accuracy, finally verified by experiments two, positioning algorithm combined with neural network positioning result is obviously better than the traditional positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Wearable Pace Speed Monitoring and Reminding System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the unreasonable running speed of runners, the related sports injuries are caused, This paper proposes a method based on acceleration sensor, combined with four order Runge Kutta algorithm and piecewise fitting temperature compensation method, The aim is real time monitoring of the running speed in the process of human movement to remind the user to adjust the running speed and achieve uniform movement in the process of running athletes, it can avoid unnecessary sports injuries. At the same time, the wireless communication method is used to receive the user's speed alarming threshold information, and the piezoelectric film material is used to generate power to improve the endurance of the system. A wearable device can adjust the speed of runners by means of vibration feedback and flash alarm. The experimental results show that the system can effectively improve the athletes running speed in the process of running, It is conducive to the cultivation of athletes healthy running habits and further promote urban civilization and healthy movement.

articleTitle: Location Related Communication Mode Selection and Spectrum Sharing for D2D Communications in Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Device to device (D2D) communications enable certain cellular users to transmit message directly with each other bypassing the base station. This can result in higher performance comparing with the traditional communication way. In this paper, we analyze the mode selection and spectrum sharing problems of D2D communications in cellular networks; a location related strategy for the joint mode selection and spectrum sharing problem is proposed. Specifically, in order to obtain better performance, D2D pairs and cellular users can choose proper communication modes and share their spectrum according to the strategy. Finally, Simulations show that, under the path loss assumption, the mode selection and spectrum sharing depend highly on the relevant locations of the involved wireless terminals.

articleTitle: An Efficient Content Based Music Retrieval Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As music can represent and transmit the rich emotion of people, it is of great importance to study on how to effective retrieve music content. Therefore, in this paper, we proposed a novel content based music retrieval algorithm, and detect main emotion of each music clip file. Afterwards, we invite several volunteers to label the emotion type of each MP3 clip to construct a training dataset, and the feature vectors of each MP3 clip is extracted. After the music type database is constructed, the music retrieval results can be achieved by music type recognition based on SVM. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with other methods, the proposed algorithm can achieve lower mean squared error and higher correlation coefficient.

articleTitle: Based on the Moving Average and Target Motion Information for Detection of Weak Small Target
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Transmission line and substation electrical equipment of Prevention and control the birds damage is a worldwide topic.On this background,we take the detection of birds which living near the high voltage electrical equipment.For background characteristics,weak small target characteristic and motion characteristics of in-depth analysis of prospects for extraction using the moving average method, followed by calculation based on neighboring frames related to the continuity of motion picture target sequence, eliminating the interference points, reducing false alarms rate. Improve the accuracy of target detection, accurate detection of bird targets.

articleTitle: Application of the DOA Algorithms in the Uniform Circular Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The conventional DOA (Direction of Arrival) estimation methods of the uniform circular array antennas use the technology of beam scanning which needs a lot of array elements. To the finite array DOA estimation, the resolution ratio is affected by the Rayleigh limit. While, the MUSIC algorithm can solve this problem, it fully utilizes the orthogonality of noise subspace and signal subspace. Because the algorithm constructs the spatial spectrum function, it can achieve the DOA estimation through the spectrum peak search. Based on the uniform circular array antennas, the Bartlett beamforming method, the Capon minimum variance method and the MUSIC algorithm are analyzed and simulated. Compared with the former two traditional algorithms, the simulation results show that the MUSIC algorithm has good precision and high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Indoor and Outdoor Integrated Location Service Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the improvement of information technology, the demand of positioning service is getting higher and higher. The rapid development of indoor and outdoor navigation positioning technology and terminal technology also provide strong technical support and market guarantee for location services. This paper introduces the composition of indoor and outdoor integrated location service system, and its application in the Internet of things and smart city. It focuses on the key technologies of indoor and outdoor navigation and positioning.

Author Keywords: Time & Code Division-Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (TC-OFDM)

articleTitle: A Music Retrieval Method Based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: How to retrieve music accurately and quickly from a large scale of music database has been a hot topic in multimedia information retrieval. In this paper, we aim to propose a novel music retrieval method with the hidden Markov model, which is regarded as the simplest dynamic Bayesian network. We extract two various forms of audio frame features and audio examples features from the audio signal in terms of the unit length in the process of feature extraction. We construct a unique HMM model for each music clip, and several HMM model are used at the same time. The original music is processed by fundamental frequency tracking and state mapping. Afterwards, music information retrieval results can be obtained based on the trained HMM model. Finally experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Home Environment Monitoring Design on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To keep abreast of home living environment, a home environment monitoring device based on Arduino was designed. With Arduino UNO hardware platform and various sensors to acquire the indoor temperature, humidity, light and combustible gas changes in real-time, then upload this to the monitoring platform, according to the collected data to adjust the surrounding environment. The test results show that the design can achieve the collection and stably upload of home environment data, and meet the design requirements of remotely monitoring the living environment conditions. The invention has follow advantages: low cost, small power consumption, simple structure and convenient installation.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Evaluation of English Teachers' Educational Ability under MOOC Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the English teachers' education ability evaluation accuracy, promote the upgrading of the level of English teacher education, the evaluation model of English teacher education ability is proposed in MOOC environment. Data fusion model of English teacher education ability evaluation index is obtained based on big data analysis method, data clustering analysis of English teaching evaluation indicators is carried out, Characteristic data of English Teaching are extracted, and combining fuzzy C means algorithm to analyze the characteristics of English teachers' educational ability in MOOC environment, adaptive mining evaluation of English teachers' educational ability is realized. Then we develop and design the evaluation system of English teacher education ability under the MOOC environment. The empirical data analysis is taken, and results show that it has good accuracy by using this method for evaluation of English teacher's ability, it improves the comprehensive evaluation level of English teachers.

articleTitle: A SIFT Algorithm Based on DOG Operator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Summary.This paper introduces a DOG. Using DOG operator to locate and determine the key points, the edge effect of DOG operator is eliminated, and finally the key point feature description is obtained. Using MATLAB to describe the key points of the collected images in various situations and match them in pairs. Simulation result shows that the key points of this algorithm are fully extracted and matching success rate is high

articleTitle: Features Extraction and Matching of Binocular Image Based on SIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper introduces a method of binocular images of feature extraction and matching. Shooting images in a variety of conditions in the laboratory describe feature points with multidimensional eigenvector descriptors and matched with minimum Euclidean distance in MATLAB. According to the experimental results, analyzing the effect of SIFT threshold and resolution on the results. The result shows that the method of binocular image of feature extraction and matching has the advantages of high matching success rate and short matching time

articleTitle: A Channel State Information Feedback and Prediction Scheme for Time-Varying Underwater Acoustic Channels
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: We consider a Channel State Information feedback and prediction scheme for time-varying underwater acoustic channels.Given the time-variant of underwater channels,it is desirable to set a feedback and prediction scheme to address the problem.With a goal of reaching the actual delayed signal-to-noise ratio(SNR) and replacing it by the estimated channel SNR,Holt-Winters (HW)prediction algorithm is developed to estimate the channel SNR.The proposed algorithm are evaluated in simulated channels.Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithms can be used as a suitable method for CSI prediction.

articleTitle: Educational Ability Evaluation of Japanese Language Teacher under MOOC Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Scientific and effective evaluation on MOOC teaching effects are important inspection way to ensure the teaching quality and learning effects. Illustrated by evaluation of educational ability of Japanese language teachers, this article adopts AHP to MOOC teaching evaluation and design a teaching evaluation index system based on MOOC with hierarchical structure. During the process of computation we propose an approach to adjust the estimation of elements in judgment matrix and test RC value, to provide rapid and effective construction of higher order judgement matrix. Under such design, we offers a case of educational ability evaluation of Japanese language teachers. The results show that this system can combine organically qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis, taking into account each factor of MOOC evaluation, to make objective and scientific decisions.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Multi-Precision Floating Point Arithmetic Unit Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Floating point arithmetic is very important in digital signal processing. It's usually to select different precision floating point numbers among various kinds of engineering application, this makes the floating point arithmetic unit capable of operating on different precision floating point numbers. The rapid development of FPGA technology provides the possibility for the flexible design of floating point arithmetic. This paper describes the process of building a general floating point arithmetic unit using Verilog HDL based on FPGA. The floating point arithmetic unit can perform addition and subtraction operations of a couple of double precision floating point numbers or two couple of single precision floating point numbers. At the end of this paper, the features and calculation correctness are proved through simulation and hardware experiments.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis and Research of Magnetic Coupling Resonant Wireless Power Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Compared with the electromagnetic induction wireless power transmission system, the magnetically coupled resonant wireless power transmission system has the advantages of high efficiency, medium-distance transmission and small electromagnetic interference outside the resonance frequency, and has become the focus of wireless power transmission. Based on the principle of magnetic coupled resonant wireless power transmission, the equivalent circuit topology of the string-and-string model is first established and the system model is analyzed. By adjusting factors such as load, quality factor, distance, resonant frequency and coupling coefficient, Transmission efficiency and output power changes in the transmission process; Finally, according to the coupled string-to-string topology of the system to produce a prototype system, the experimental data verify the correctness of the simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Visual Communication Graphics Design under Mobile Terminal Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The mobile terminal has been a type of an essential tool in our daily life. When we use mobile devices, we should pay attention to its visual aesthetic experience. Therefore, in this paper, we focus on the problem of dynamic visual communication graphics design under mobile terminal platform. As the characteristics of mobile Internet determine that the design of small screen pages is an important issue we should solve, the design objectives and principles of mobile terminal platform design are discussed in advance. Afterwards, principles of dynamic visual communication graphics design are given, and four main principles are proposed for the UI design of mobile terminal platform. Finally, we provide some examples of user interface designs for mobile terminal platform, and we can observe that utilizing the proposed design principles, high quality UI designs can be obtained.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of TCM Pulse Analysis and Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Health is the most important part of our daily life, and the development of smart city can not be separated from the intelligent medical. This paper analyzes the imperfection of the existing Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) information management system, describes the importance of the combination management of pulse signals and their related information of the patient. In this paper, we design and implement an auxiliary management system of Chinese medicine pulse. The system consists of a set of pulse acquisition equipment, a piece of software written by C# language, and an Android App of daily management for a mobile terminal.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive English Speech Recognition Algorithm in Multimedia Cooperative Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Multi-media overcomes the defects of traditional teaching means so foreign language teaching rapidly develops with such technology. It becomes a bottleneck to restrict intelligence learning software development. To solve the problem, this paper discuss basic knowledge in speech recognition and studies targeted corpus according to English pronunciation habit of Chinese people. Integrated with oral English learners’ requirements with Chinese as native language, this paper applies DTW model-based speech recognition technology for Viterbi decoding speech, then it recognizes and scores through posterior probability. After experiment verification, English pronunciation recognition model in this paper is verified to be reasonable and credible and it can offer learners’ timely, accurate and objective evaluation and feedback direction to correct pronunciation errors to improve oral English learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Big Data in Academic Libraries
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper proposes a big data application model system of academic library. From the perspective of big data collection and integration, big data analysis methods, knowledge services, and the shortage of resources, this paper analyzes the plight of library big data application and then constructs a library big data application model system based on large scale network analysis method. This library big data application model based on knowledge management theory and open source cloud computing platform based on large scale network analysis method can face the challenge of big data service in academic library and effectively promote the further development of big data service in academic library.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technology in the CRM of Pharmaceutical Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The paper describes the Customer Relationship Management ,the technology of Data Mining and its application in CRM of Enterprise of Medical Industry. It uses an algorithm called Classification Tree to demonstrate the importance of Data Mining in CRM of Enterprise of Medical Industry.

articleTitle: Temperature and Humidity Detection System of Communication System Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Temperature and humidity information is an important quality index of communication system. A temperature and humidity sensor network is constructed based on Raspberry Pi development platform and temperature and humidity sensor. The temperature and humidity sensor network can monitor the temperature and humidity of the communication system, and then transmit the measured parameters to the remote server in time by IP network, and carry out the corresponding data processing, which can realize the basic security protection of the communication system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring System Based on Hi3531 for Recognition of Human Falling Action
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The construction of a smart city is the trend of urbanization, and it is bound to unstoppable that the traditional video monitoring system is replaced by a of intelligent monitoring system with specific functions. In this paper, a behavior recognition method based on spatiotemporal shape feature is adopted, and the algorithm is transplanted into embedded chip Hi3531 to realize the real-time alarm for human falling action. Firstly, we extract foreground by the addition of Gaussian mixture background modeling method and three inter-frame difference method. And then, in order to the extraction of feature and the recognition of falling action, we calculate the Hu moment feature twice from Motion Energy Image of motion video sequence, combining with the naive bayesian classifier to classify and recognize. Board-level experiments show that this system can realize real-time alarm when a man fall down.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Power Network Equipment Management System Based on Radio Frequency Identification Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional power grid equipment management has the problems of rigid management mode, data sharing, low security and so on, which cannot meet the requirements of the development of smart grid. The Internet of things technology can put all objects on the internet. By means of signal docking and communication technology, the intelligent identification, tracking, positioning, manipulation and surveillance of the equipment are completed. Therefore, the research on the smart grid equipment management system based on the Internet of things is of practical significance and engineering application value to reduce costs, realize data sharing, and improve the level of power grid equipment management. In view of the current problems in power grid equipment management, the intelligent grid equipment management system based on Internet of things and cloud computing platform is studied. The results show that the smart grid equipment management system based on the Internet of things technology is feasible. It can solve some problems existing in today's power system equipment management.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Genetic Algorithm in Vehicle Networked Cloud Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Under the car networking user group, the traditional cloud computing data scheduling mostly adopts the algorithm of generating initial data by randomization and the fitness function of single indicator. This can not meet the diverse needs of front-end users and the effective use of background resources, resulting in low user satisfaction and inefficient operation of the algorithm.In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved genetic algorithm model that uses population matching function to initialize population and user QoS model to construct fitness function of genetic algorithm. In this paper, the balance algorithm of the front-end user and back-end server resources is designed creatively, so that the optimal solution can meet the needs of the front and rear end. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm is superior to the traditional genetic algorithm and min-min algorithm in the implementation efficiency, system load balancing and user satisfaction of the application layer of car networking, which is an efficient task scheduling algorithm.

articleTitle: Digital Inheritance Strategy of Intangible Cultural Heritage and Big Data Model - Taking the Southern Liaoning Province as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Digital protection of intangible cultural heritage creates conditions for the sustainable development of national culture. The digital protection of southern Liaoning intangible cultural heritage is still in the stage of development, and the protection and inheritance of the intangible cultural heritage is facing new challenges and opportunities. The digital protection technologies of intangible cultural heritage and balance of regional cultural ecology are explored. In addition, a new discipline of digital intangible cultural heritage is established for strengthening strategic and interdisciplinary research. What’s more, a set of scientific operation and management mechanism of digital protection of intangible cultural heritage is gradually formed.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Greening Landscape Design of Urban Roads Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the visual landscape quality of urban road green, AHP is adopted to perform comprehensive evaluation of greening landscape aesthetics for street greening landscape of certain city and achieve the weight of each evaluation factor. By computation it is concluded that in defined criteria layer, the most important factor is the art of color collocation whose weight is 0.332. In the factor layer, the more important 3 factors are artistic expression of color construction, rationality of plant collocation and expression of formal beauty. In comprehensive evaluation grade of greening landscape of high side slope of urban trunk road, level II and level IV are more, while level I and level III are less. Therefore, the prime problem to be improved is to balance the function of traffic accessibility and road greening landscape of major roads.

articleTitle: The Design of Tunnel Lighting Intelligent Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the light environment and energy saving,a tunnel lighting control system is designed in this paper.Zigbee technology is used to realize the wireless control of LED lamps through the Coordinator and Terminal nodes.The information of luminance in the tunnels and whether the cars passes by and so on is collected through Light sensor and Doppler shift sensor.The brightness of Led lamps are adjusted automatically through PWM light adjustment scheme.Finally,the system is verified.The results show that the control system can adjust the light in real time and it has a certain practical value.

articleTitle: A New Bin Packing Algorithm with Buffer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper we study the classical bin packing problem with a buffer of constant size. There are n items with size within (0,1] and when a new item is given, it can be stored in the buffer temporarily or packed into some bin.Once it is packed in the bin, we cannot repack it. It has been proved as a NP-hard problem by some researchers when P ≠ NP. We proposed an online algorithm with asymptotic competitive ratio 1.71 in this paper.

articleTitle: Algorithm and Implementation of Education Platform Client/Server Architecture Based on Android System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to alleviate the unbalanced development of education and provide students with high-quality teaching resources, an Android-based educational platform is designed and developed. Users can access the teaching resources on the platform through the software and complete the learning tasks on this software. In this paper, Android-side interaction design, server communication methods, and algorithm-specific logic functions are introduced. A well-structured database model is designed to efficiently store data and user information. At the same time, database and Android software communication methods are discussed. Finally, the user data is organized based on data mining methods. Therefore, a network communication protocol is designed. The database server can receive and modify data to achieve the purpose of mutual communication.

articleTitle: Application Research of Optimized FCE Method in Information Security Risk Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Contraposing to the features of information system security risk in information incompleteness and conception uncertainty this article establishes a more comprehensive model for risk evaluation based on related analysis on risk factors. It integrated clustering method and FCE in fuzzy mathematics to quantify objective evaluation results of information security risk. Then the rule of “one man one vote” is introduced to explain fuzzy rule knowledge of experts marks. For each risk factor weight we introduce entropy index computation to over come the object effect caused by direct evaluation by experts, to achieve more scientific and rational evaluations. Illustrated by analysis and evaluation of the information security management system of certain power grid enterprise, the effectiveness and feasibility of improved FCE proposed in this article is verified.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Large Data Differentiation Classification Technology under the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Differential classification of large data in the environment of Internet of things can improve the clustering ability of large data, a large data dissimilation classification method is proposed based on fuzzy C mean clustering and piecewise fusion scheduling. The large data set under the Internet of things is divided into several subsets by using the method of grid region segmentation, feature matching and redundant filtering for large data of mass Internet of things is taken by piecewise matching detection, adaptive attribute merging of large data differentiation characteristics in physical network is realized. The high order spectral features of the large data flow of the Internet of things are excavated, and the fuzzy C means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the difference characteristics of large data. Combining the piecewise fusion matching scheduling method to improve the feature matching ability of large data classification, and realize the classification and optimization of large data differentiation under the Internet of things. The simulation results show that this method is used to classify large data under the Internet of things, the accuracy of differential feature extraction is higher, the clustering of data classification is better, and the misclassification rate of large data classification is low.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of English Teaching Management System Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligence of the English teaching management, so as to improve the English teaching resource scheduling and sharing ability, a design method of teaching management system is proposed based on Web. The system adopts Web network architecture design, mainly it is divided into MUC main control module, database module, data management module and man-machine interaction module, Network management and online scheduling of English teaching resources are obtained based on C/S framework, data exchange of English teaching resources is realized on client side and server side, the control component of the English teaching resource distribution database uses MBM29LV400BC as the logic decoding controller. The intelligent algorithm is used to analyze the big data to realize the scheduling and access control of the English teaching management system resources. The test results show that the design of the English teaching management system has good resource scheduling and database construction ability, and the overall intelligence of the system is better.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Management System for College Students
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To enhance the functions including declaration, comment, medium-term inspection, concluded verification and funds management, it is necessary to implement modern computer technology to develop the system of college students’ innovation and entrepreneurship training plan management. The system adopts B/S structure and programming development which is established on object-oriented advantages of JAVA language. Certain maintenance operations such as system data storage are completed by applying MSSQL2015 database. Our system offers general design and functional module design of each sub-modules. Furthermore, it introduces database design in the system and basic data table design as well as corresponding realization. The mapping of entity-association graph from entity to table and mapping between entity relationships are used to design the database. After trial for certain time, the system is effectively operated to basically realize the design target

articleTitle: City's Wisdom and Innovation Design Based on City Public Environment Facilities
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to explore the practice of city public facilities design, by means of system theory and the combination of quality research and quantity research, elements, levels and systems of city public environment facilities are analyzed. Based on this, the city public environment facilities are designed with city’s culture as the orientation, and it also orientates towards the city operation and management. In this way, a city public service system that is beneficial for the people is designed, which is open and has multi layers. In a word, the wisdom and innovation design of city public environment facilities promotes the city’s environment becoming systemic. What’s more, it perfects the classification and management of public facilities with city’s life requirements as the orientation.

articleTitle: Land-Use Degree and Spatial Autocorrelation Analysis in Kunming City Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper applies the theory of spatial correlation, basing on big data of ENVI remote sensing image interpretation and the land use data of 14 counties in Kunming, to analyze the spatial autocorrelation of land use structure and land use degree in Kunming in 2005, 2011 and 2015 with Moran Index I. The research shows: (1) The share of cultivated land and vegetation coverage in the land use structure of Kunming are large, but the area of cultivated land is decreasing while the area of construction land is increasing. (2)There is a global spatial autocorrelation of land use in Kunming, but the correlation is weakening. (3)There is local spatial autocorrelation clustering in land use degree in Kunming, including four types: high - high agglomerations(HH), high - low agglomerations(LL), low - low agglomerations, and low - high agglomerations(LH). But the agglomerations are weakening.

articleTitle: Subliminal Channel and Digital Currency Pay Security
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper constructs a subliminal channel model suitable for payment of safe digital currency.On the basis of the study of the E1Gamal digital signature scheme, the wide-band subliminal channel and the narrow-band subliminal channel are studied, the security of these two subliminal channels in digital currency payment is analyzed theoretically,it is concluded that I - type wide-band subliminal channel can be used for the mutual trust of the two parties in the transaction, while II type narrow-band subliminal channel can effectively prevent the risk of forged signature.On the basis of this, this paper proposes a method to construct the subliminal channel based on tripartite payment method, and its security is verified theoretically.

articleTitle: PLC Intelligent Transportation Signal Control Based on Algorithm of Function Block Conversion to Instruction List
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: PLC intelligent transportation signal control is the difficulty point in the urban rail transit control. In this paper, a kind of PLC intelligent transportation signal control method based on the algorithm of function block conversion to instruction list (hereinafter referred to as AFBCIL for short) is put forward. In this method, the control deviation of the PLC intelligent transportation signal is equivalent to the inter-symbol interference signal, and the control performance of the PLC transportation signal is improved by the feedback information from the functional block conversion to instruction list. The simulation results show that: The experimental results have verified the versatility of the algorithm put forward in this paper, which can convert complex control logic function blocks with multiple outputs into the instruction list statements. And during the process of compilation and conversion, the proposed method has simplified the program very effectively, saved more memory space, and improved the efficiency of the compilation and conversion of the PLC function block diagram.

Author Keywords: Algorithm of Function Block Conversion to Instruction List

articleTitle: PSO Optimized Semi-Supervised Network Traffic Classification Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The network traffic classification methods based on PSO optimized semi-supervised learning. Towards the deficiency of traditional machine learning methods such as k-means and KNN, PSO technology is adopted in this paper to improve these algorithms. We also introduce the learning conception of semi-supervision, to solve the problem of time and efficiency which is hard to be avoided in supervised learning, and a network traffic classification system is designed based on the improved algorithm. The experimental results indicate PSO optimized KNN algorithm has faster convergence speed compared to KNN and it is not easy to fall into local optimum.

articleTitle: Research on Optimized Allocation of English Teaching Resources Based on Network Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The allocation of resources in English teaching can improve the ability of resource sharing, in order to optimize the allocation of resources, so as to improve the performance of English teaching, and promote the construction of English teaching resources database, a method of optimizing the allocation of English teaching resources is proposed based on network cloud platform. Text semantic key words conceptual decision tree model is constructed for massive English teaching resources allocation, semantic information conversion method is used to compute key semantic features of English Teaching resources, the concept convergence point of English Teaching resource allocation is formed in semantic model. According to the set between the upper and lower relationship, a decision tree model of English Teaching semantic subject words is constructed, semantic conversion and information extraction are realized. English teaching resources optimization allocation simulation is taken in the cloud platform, simulation results show that the scheduling performance of English teaching resources is better, and the adaptive allocation ability of English teaching resources is stronger, and the resource utilization rate is higher.

articleTitle: Design of Multi Direction Real-Time Online Edge Detection System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the detection results of traditional single image or two direction edge is not ideal, the direction is not strong, the problem of low efficiency of detection, and proposes an improved edge detection algorithm based on FPGA multi direction, give full play to the FPGA internal resources the advantages of parallel processing of digital signal. The algorithm in the original 0 degrees, 90 degrees two direction on the basis of increase 22.5 degrees, 45 degrees, 67.5 degrees, 112.5 degrees, 135 degrees and 157.5 degrees in six directions of the Sobel template, can better detect multi direction edge. Considering the center pixel and its neighbor pixels in different distance from the impact algorithm are weighted according to the pixels of each pixel to pixel Euclidean distance to the center in the neighborhood, the distance of the center pixel closer, the greater weight, and by programmable adder and programmable parallel adder to improve the detection efficiency. The experimental results show that the algorithm can real-time online, efficient detection of complete image’s edge information and contour lines are clear, directional, and has a high significance.

articleTitle: Research on Structural Changes in China Domestic and Inbound Tourism Based on Big Data Statistical Method (1994-2014)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This research applies big data for tourism statistics and tourism areas and attractions monitoring as well as the Yearbook of China Tourism Statistics. It has studied structural changes in China domestic and inbound tourism from 1994 to 2014 based on big data statistical analysis method. The analysis result shows that since 1994, contributions to national economic growth made by China’s tourism industry had become more and more obvious. Domestic tourism become gradually the main body of China’s tourism industry and the main source of tourism revenue. Inbound tourism played an important role in the development of China’s tourism industry. However, the proportion of international tourism receipts in total tourism revenue of China become lower and lower, decreasing from 38.15% in 1994 to 10.34% in 2014; at the same time, the development of China’s tourism industry was also influenced by domestic and international situation, impacts of “atypical pneumonia” in 2003 and the international financial crisis that began in 2008 were the most typical.

articleTitle: Studied on Application of Double Encryption Algorithm in Covert Channel Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the process of mobile intelligent terminal for file transfer, ensure the safety of data transmission is significant. It is necessary to prevent the file from being eavesdropped and tampered during transmission. The method of using double encryption on covert channel is proposed in this paper based on the analysis of encryption algorithms and covert channel, which uses asymmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt the key of symmetric encryption, to form hidden information, and to carry out covert transmission through covert channels to enhance the security of mobile terminal data transmission. By simulating the above scenarios in intelligent mobile terminal, the confidentiality and concealment of important information are realized in the transmission process.

articleTitle: Application of Dendrobium Compound Preparation in the Health Environment of Big Data Smart City
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To explore the potential nutritional value of Dendrobium compound preparation, the antioxidant mechanism of Dendrobium compound preparation was studied from the perspective of composition. The physiological changes of human body after taking Dendrobium compound preparation were analyzed under the health environment of big data smart city. The total composition and total sugar content in the Dendrobium compound preparation extract (DCPE) was determined, and its antioxidant activity was evaluated from the cellular level. The results showed that a total of 28 kinds of component compounds were identified in the fruits of Dendrobium compound, in which 8 Dendrobium amine derivatives were identified for the first time. In vitro tests showed that the total component and total sugar content in DCPE were 3,320 mg GAE •s 100g-1 DW and 570 mg DCPE • 100g-1 DW, respectively. Further studies showed that DCPE could effectively reduce the level of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reduced glutathione (GSH) in human cloned colon cancer cells (Caco-2) in the big data smart city health environment, with dose-dependent effects, which proved that DCPE could significantly enhance the antioxidant activity of Caco-2 cells at the cellular level. In summary, Dendrobium compound preparation contains a large number of component compounds, with relatively strong antioxidant activity by means of transdermal preparation, and can be widely applied in nutritious food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and various natural products.

Author Keywords: Health Environment of Big Data Smart City

articleTitle: The Design of Network Pedometer Based on Bluetooth 4.0
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The pedometer combined with Bluetooth 4.0 can effectively implement the communication with the laptops, PAD? and mobile phones. it can more accurately calculate the number of pace through the method of real-time digital filter smoothing data curve, the design not only can enhance people's enthusiasm of taking exercise but also can effectively save communication resource. Because of the Bluetooth technology is in the 2.4 GHz band which is free spectrum [1], Bluetooth technology is bound to get more widely applications and more recognition, it can effectively put the data recorded by pedometer sent to the mobile phone and other modern terminal devices through Bluetooth technology, and then the data is uploaded to the cloud server to be saved through the terminal. This can increase people's interest in the pedometer, because the relevant data can be visible saved for a long time, it tracks more convenient for people to exercise and reach the effect of physical fitness. So it is convenient for people to track and compare the physical activity to reach the effect of physical fitness.

articleTitle: Intelligent Wheelchair Based on Brainwave
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the acceleration of the aging population and the increase of accidents, the number of people with disabilities, especially those with hands and feet, continues to increase. The disabled is a special component of the human society, and they are faced with many difficulties in their lives. In order to improve their quality of life, the disabled wheelchair based on brain wave detection was studied. Based on the key technology of brain wave module identification, multiple sensors, GPS module, wireless transmission module, single-chip microcomputer and Android, The intelligent wearable device is designed and equipped with the functions of brain wave control, automatic obstacle avoidance, navigation and positioning, mobile phone terminal control, etc. With many kinds of technology integration, multi-intelligence network to realize the multi-functional disability tools, the main goal is to solve the problem of disabled people's travel and mobility.

articleTitle: Research and Design of the High Voltage Line Interphase Short Circuit Fault Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to determine the fault type of high voltage line accurately in a short time, a device based on high frequency injection method to judge the fault type is designed. The device consists of charging control module, super capacitor group, high frequency inverter module and intelligent control module. The specific work process is to produce high-frequency carrier through high-frequency inverter module for high frequency injection, and judge the fault type by the discharge status or discharge current of the super capacitor. Computer simulation and hardware verification are given to illustrate the simulation results. The results show that the type of interphase short-circuit fault can be determined.

Author Keywords: The method of high frequency injection

articleTitle: Research on the Early Intelligent Warning System of Lost Circulation Based on Fuzzy Expert System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The reasons for the drilling process such as getting fuzzy, incomplete or uncertain information, and the lack of adjacent well data, it is difficult for the lost circulation warning to establish an accurate mathematical model by use of the traditional method or establish intelligent model based on sample information. Therefore, an intelligent method for the early warning of lost circulation in well drilling based on fuzzy expert system is proposed in this paper, and the corresponding early warning software system is developed. First of all, the system inputs the experience and knowledge of experts into the fuzzy rule base, and uses the fuzzy production rules to represent knowledge, at the same time lost circulation characteristic parameters are fuzzified, and then combined with the fuzzy inference machine to resolve the problem by reasoning, so as to realize the intelligent early warning of lost circulation. Finally, the system is tested by field data. The results show that the warning method can meet the requirements of field application, and can effectively improve the accuracy and intelligent level of the early lost circulation warning.

articleTitle: Non-Contact Low-Power Proximity Switch Based on Kitchen Garbage Crusher
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the contact operation problem of the mechanical switch button of the kitchen garbage crusher, a non-contact low-power gesture proximity switch is proposed in this paper. The realization scheme of proximity switch is discussed, and the importance of gesture recognition proximity switch in intelligent control of kitchen waste crusher is further explained. Using 32 bit ARM processor of Cortex-M3 kernel, combined with APDS-9960 environment brightness optical sensor, accurate recognition of human dynamic gestures is realized. Considering the power consumption of the device, the processor's shutdown wake-up mode and the low power miniature induction PIR sensor wake-up system is adopted, Ultra low power consumption is achieved. The experimental results show that the gesture recognition rate of the proximity switch is more than 93%, the normal operating current of the device is 38mA, and the working current of the shutdown mode is less than 20uA. Compared with the traditional contact type mechanical buttons, kitchen garbage grinder adopts non-contact gesture proximity switch, the user operation will be more convenient, fast, health, it will provide the basis for the realization of future intelligent appliances and the wisdom of the city.

articleTitle: EMS Cooperative Pricing Mechanism Optimization for Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The cooperative development of express industry in the context of China's electronic commerce is discussed in this paper. The express price of ecommerce market is studied and the connotation and characteristics of pricing for express service are analyzed. Then based on traditional supply and demand theory, non-cooperative game method is adopted to introduce multiple factors to pricing mechanism during the pricing process, to establish more comprehensive model which is closer to actual logistics pricing. The case applies pricing model to the competitive pricing of two express enterprises and get solution by game analysis and computation, achieving the final balanced price of both sides. The price is verified to be an optimal pricing choice to be taken as the reasonable express price for the third party logistics.

articleTitle: Service-Oriented Logistics Supply Chain Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order for rapid, accurate and low-cost information exchange among supply chain enterprises during logistics business operation, this paper puts forward solution scheme to construct public logistics supply chain information exchange platform. Based on service-oriented framework, the platform adopts heterogeneous data exchange engine and data exchange agent to perform certain services functions such as end-to-end data exchange of heterogeneous information system in supply-chain enterprises, zero-development access, etc. The system test result shows function and performance of this platform can completely satisfy the requirements of logistics supply-chain enterprises information exchange and the system has the perfect openness and scalability.

articleTitle: The Construction of Evaluation Model of Chinese Traditional Culture Multimedia Teaching Resources Allocation in Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
