abstract: This paper presents a method to construct evaluation model of Chinese traditional culture multimedia teaching resources allocation in the big data environment. Firstly, it randomly distributes teaching resources allocation of Chinese traditional culture multimedia teaching as a point on the plane in a plane area; then according to the clustering method in the big data environment, makes clustering analysis by selecting group similarity coefficient from small to large; finally, in the plane area uses the recursive algorithm to collect the clustering results so to obtain the Chinese traditional culture multimedia teaching model with different teaching characteristics. Based on the multimedia classroom teaching, this paper compares and analyzes the algorithm results with those of other classical clustering algorithms. The results show that the construction method of evaluation model of Chinese traditional culture multimedia teaching resources allocation in big data environment can meet the requirements of classroom teaching, especially in multimedia classroom teaching, this method has characteristics such as intuitiveness, obvious category features etc.

articleTitle: The Research on Performance Evaluation of Low Carbon Supply Chain Based on ISM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, it is an inevitable choice to accelerate the transformation of low-carbon enterprises and enhance international competitiveness. This paper synthesizes domestic and foreign research results and knowledge of relevant knowledge, and makes a further study on the performance evaluation of low carbon supply chain. Introducing low-carbon environmental factors on the basis of Balanced Scorecard, redesigned a set of performance evaluation index system and the index structure model (ISM) was used to decompose the index system to improve the performance.

articleTitle: An Online English Course Teaching Model Based on Scene Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the English online courses teaching scene adaptability, optimize the online English teaching mode, improve the quality of English teaching, an English online course teaching platform is proposed based on scene simulation. B/S client communication protocol is constructed in network transport layer, and the scene simulation model of English Online Course Teaching is established, online English teaching platform designed in this paper is constructed based on the sensing layer, network layer and application layer. A data processing center is constructed in the B/S structure and the network environment, Open Core kernel is used to realize the optimization of teaching model of English online courses, improve the teaching platform of online courses, and improve the scene adaptation ability. The test results show that the platform for online English teaching has better independent learning ability, the effectiveness of online English course teaching is better, test objects have higher satisfaction with English Online Course Teaching.

articleTitle: A Discourse Parser Language Model Based on Improved Neural Network in Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The development of statistical machine translation technology is so fast and there are many new models and methods. This obtains great achievement in translation of simple sentence or fixed sentence with certain applications. However, there still exists poor coherence and low readability complex long sentence translation. In order to measure discourse coherence and adapt to more tasks more effectively, this paper puts forward a word vector characteristic-based the improved method of recurrent neural network language model. This method increases feature layer in input layer. The improved model structure adds context word vector through feature layer during model training and enhances learning ability in long-distance information restriction. The experiment result shows that our proposed hierarchical recurrence neural network-based discourse language model has a better performance which is beyond current optimal system.

articleTitle: Application Study on Data Mining Technology of English Learning Virtual Community
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper puts forward a novel multidimensional foreign language learning community. Different form traditional virtual learning community, it evaluates, classifies through real-time and dynamic students' learning status and automatically introduces students to operate group-learning in different abilities levels of learning community. During the process of design and realization of students' evaluation classification, this article adopts students' learning process data from ontology technology-based multimode interactive network learning environment to generate cognitive diagnosis model which accurately reflects students' learning status. With comprehensive analysis consideration, we choose reasonable and effective clustering algorithm, implement cluster analysis in model and realizes data mining application of system in E-learning environment successfully.

articleTitle: Research on Travel Time Prediction under Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A key information service of Internet of Vehicle (IOV) is route optimization. As an important basis, travel time prediction receives more attention. In order to achieve the effect of timely route optimization must be timely, reliable and highly accurate. Under IOV environment, traffic volume and density can be determined through information intercommunication between the vehicle and infrastructure. Travel time can be predicted by using artificial neural network (ANN) and support vector machine based on existing travel time and given traffic volume and density. The paper researches the travel time prediction model based on ANN and least square support vector machine under IOV environment, designs a simulation platform to conduct simulation with measured data, result shows that proposed least square support vector machine travel time prediction model has good performance.

articleTitle: Adaptive Canny Operator Based Digital Image Processing Scheme for Photoshop Filter Plugin Unit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: For the application of image processing of large scale high precision scanner project, improvement research and concrete realization of Canny algorithm based on plugin system in Photoshop are studied in this article. First, the filtering function and filtering window are adaptively selected according to Gauss filtering principle and characteristic statistical analysis. Then, 3×3 SoUel edge operator is used to replace 2×2 finite difference in neighborhood to compute the gradient magnitude. Finaly, the high-low threshold of Canny operatpr is computed by mean value and variance mean of image. The experimental results indicate that our method overcomes the edge information loss caused by traditional canny algorithm, and it has strong adaptability in detecting edge details.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Criminal Law Case Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: It is of great importance to effectively manage criminal law case for public security informationization. Therefore, in this paper, we discuss how to design the criminal law case information management system. Main feature of this paper lies in that B/S structure is used to develop the proposed system, and B/S structure is belonged to a typical thin client, in which the client uses a single Browser software. Particularly, the proposed system contains two modules, 1) Security case subsystem, and 2) Criminal case subsystem. The aim of criminal case information system is to combine all links in tackling criminal cases and administrative cases into an information management system, and then propose a comprehensive solution for case handling, case enquiry and file management. We can see that the proposed system is able to enhance the business processing and information acquisition modes of the local police station, and then improve the efficiency of its work.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Data Mining in Virtual Community of Foreign Language Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The construction of virtual community in foreign language learning is a comprehensive foreign language learning environment integrated with foreign language vocabulary database construction and vocabulary retrieval, combining the virtual reality technology to construct the language environment of foreign language learning. The virtual community of foreign language learning can improve the sense of language authenticity in foreign language learning and improve the quality of foreign language teaching. A method of building a virtual community for foreign language learning is proposed based on data mining technology, data acquisition and feature preprocessing model for building semantic vocabulary of foreign language learning is constructed, the linguistic environment characteristics of the semantic vocabulary data of foreign language learning is analyzed, and the semantic noumenon structure model is obtained. Fuzzy clustering method is used for vocabulary clustering and comprehensive retrieval in the virtual community of foreign language learning, the performance of vocabulary classification in foreign language learning is improved, the adaptive semantic information fusion method is used to realize the vocabulary data mining in the virtual community of foreign language learning, information retrieval and access scheduling for virtual communities in foreign language learning are realized based on data mining results. The simulation results show that the accuracy of foreign language vocabulary retrieval is good, improve the efficiency of foreign language learning.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Method of Sports Modernization Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the modernization level of sports comprehensive evaluation, a comprehensive evaluation method of sports modernization based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is proposed. An index analysis model for constructing the comprehensive evaluation of sports modernization is constructed, spatial modeling of information feature distribution is taken based on nonlinear time series analysis method for comprehensive evaluation of sports modernization, control objective function of comprehensive evaluation of sports modernization is constructed by analytic hierarchy process, optimal control parameters is obtained and comprehensive evaluation and optimization of sports modernization are realized. The simulation results show that the method is applied in comprehensive evaluation modern sports, it has performance of high reliability and good accuracy.

articleTitle: Queries Based on Data Attribute Spatial Index in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A kind of data storage model based on local clustering has been presented specific to the issue of expensive data query and communication expenses while limited bandwidth resources in existing Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). By dividing an entire network as per geographic positions, the model can cluster storage by using local data, which avoids the excessive communication expenses caused by sending identical data to one memory spot, so as to balance communication bandwidth. Based on the data storage model, a kind of data queries method based on data attribute spatial index (SIQ) has been presented. In SIQ,only storage nodes are used to build leaf nodes for indexes; compared with indexes built by using all nodes, the number of maintained nodes is limited and the cost of building such indexes is lower. In addition, the attribute for the data used by SIQ is the contents of spatial index, which can effectively make multiple-attributive range queries for monitored data. According to simulation results, compared with relatively mature Directed Diffusion (DD) algorithm and Geographic Hash Table (GHT) algorithm, SIQ can overcome high communication complexity caused by flooding queries.

articleTitle: Research on Speech Visualization Technology and Its Application in English Listening Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of English Listening Teaching, the characteristics analysis of speech signals in English Listening is taken based on speech visualization technology, and visualization research of speech in English listening teaching is realized. A listening speech signal feature extraction and recognition method is proposed based on sensing method of Mel frequency cepstral coefficients, the collected English speech signals are processed with action attributes matching of the pronunciation organs, MLP detector is used for information recognition and feature extraction of speech sounds, hierarchical artificial neural network is used for SSM decoding of the signal, the visual spectrum analysis of speech signals in English Listening Teaching is realized, the detection and recognition of English speech signal are obtained with matched filter detector, speech analysis and recognition ability of English listening teaching is improved, the expression ability of the matching features is stronger, the accuracy of speech recognition is better, and the application effect of English listening teaching is improved.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Management Information System for College Students' Ideological and Political Education
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The development of College Students' Ideological and political education management information system can improve intelligence and stability of the management of Ideological and political education, and improve the teaching resources information sharing and utilization ability. A design scheme of Ideological and political education management information system is proposed based on Cloud-P2P fusion model and multi thread scheduling, the overall design framework of the information management system is obtained, Cloud-P2P fusion model is taken for fusion and scheduling of college students' Ideological and political education management information. NET Framework. ADO. NET is developed, and the role access control method is taken as the key technology for information management system software development, network communication module development of the management system is developed based on TCP/IP protocol and C/S mode, the design of integrated development of information management system is completed. The test results shows that the development of College Students' Ideological and political education management information system is this paper has good ability of resource scheduling and management, it has good application value in practice.

articleTitle: Study on Load Balancing of Intermittent Energy Big Data Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the development of construction on smart grid and the reasonable utilization of intermittent energy source, data processing on traditional platform can not already satisfy the intermittent energy sources. It must be a great challenge for the whole platform. According to the superiority of cloud platform on processing data as well as the load balancing of the overall cluster on the cloud platform, this paper proposes a strategy that the cloud platform is integrated with the intermittent energy sources data and the load balancing of multi-factor predictive cloud platform. Firstly, deploying the overall process of the intermittent energy data processing on a new data processing platform, and then running the multi-factor predictive cloud platform load balancing on the processing platform. Finally, simulations and experiments prove that the data processing platform proposed provides better performance and will promote the construction of smart grids.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of Receiving Scheme for HF High Data Rate Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Joint designing of diversity combining and channel equalization at the receiver improved the performance of HF-HDRT system greatly.The performance of the iteration combining-equalization (ICE) algorithms and its frequency domain implementation are excellent. However the different algorithm has the different performance and complexity. So the optimized algorithm is exist to the specific service. In order to solve this problem, a optimization method is proposed for receiving scheme through following the extrinsic information transfer (EXIT) charts. The optimization parameters for a selected ICE algorithm is given firstly, and then the optimization ICE algorithm with the minimum complexity is gotten. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: Research on Complex Network Modeling of Cellular Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing has led to a new way of production and cooperation among manufacturers, at which time all manufacturers can synchronize their manufacturing data to the cloud. However, how to select the appropriate cooperation enterprises and production lines according to the mass data is crucial. Recently, the study of complex network provides a new solution for this. Based on the characteristics of cellular manufacturing resource nodes and complex networks, a complex network modeling that can reflect the real cellular manufacturing system is proposed, in which the individual enterprise is treated as the resource node of a cellular manufacturing system and the production line is treated as the linkage among nodes. Based on the comparison of several existing models, some properties of practical significance are added to the node, which changes the probability of node to be connected. In addition, limiting the connection order of nodes and adding weight to the edge can make the network directed-weighted. Finally, the degree distribution, average clustering coefficient and average shortest path length of complex network under different modeling are compared. Results of simulations show that the modeling of cellular manufacturing system lay over the Internet proposed in this paper is feasible.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process Based Volleyball Quality Evaluation for College Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the quality of volleyball teaching, integrated with the characteristics of volleyball itself, four aspects of volleyball teaching in colleges and universities are discussed in this article. We design a evaluation index system to reflect the teaching capability of volleyball teachers, which is materialized and analyzed by mathematical statistics, analytic hierarchy process, and logical analysis etc. Then the fuzzy evaluation based on AHP is adopted to establish index system and solve the problem in weight assignment, passing the consistency test by experiments. The empirical analysis shows that our scheme can scientifically evaluate the teaching ability of volleyball teachers in colleges. It provides certain theoretical reference for the development of volleyball teachers and improvement of teaching quality of physical education in colleges.

articleTitle: Business Management System and Information Analysis Platform for Economic Innovation Projects
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve business management and information analysis ability of economic innovation project, an evaluation and analysis method of business management information of economic innovation project is proposed based on Hausman test method, construction of business management system and information analysis platform for economic innovation projects is taken under the cloud computing platform and embedded environment. First, the main component analysis model is used to design the information prediction algorithm for the business management system of the economic innovation project. The information statistics model of economic innovation project is constructed by Hausman test, optimization design of business management and information analysis for economic innovation projects are obtained. Construction of information fusion platform for information analysis platform is taken under the cloud computing platform to realize large data parallel processing and improve information fusion and computing power. In the embedded environment, the software development is carried out to realize the optimization design of the business management system and information analysis platform of the economic innovation project. The test results show that this method can improve the analysis and scheduling capability of business information, it has good stability, the accuracy of the information analysis and prediction of the economic innovation project is good.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Face Recognition System Based on ARM Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve ability of face recognition and detection, an improved face recognition system is proposed based on ARM architecture design, software development of face recognition system is taken in ARM embedded platform. The image edge contour detection method is used for face image features positioning, the adaptive feature extraction method of image entropy is used for facial feature extraction, the face recognition algorithm is optimized, and the user application program, the bus driver module, the information interaction module and the face image output module are constructed. The application development of face recognition system is taken based on ARM architecture, GNU development tools are used for program loading and compilation of face recognition algorithm, the optimization design of face recognition system is completed. The simulation results show that the face recognition system designed in this paper has good robustness performance, and it can improve the accurate probability of face recognition.

articleTitle: Research of Wolf Pack Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Wolf Pack Algorithm(WPA) proposed in 2011 is one of the swarm intelligence optimization algorithms, which has been widely used in many fields such as artificial neural network, medical science, optimization triaxial sensor placement, optimization operation of hydropower station and so on. At present, WPA has been obtained good application results in above fields. However, the same as other swarm intelligence optimization algorithms, during the study period, WPA has some problems need to be discussed such as how to improve the performance of the algorithm in optimization problems and expanding algorithm application fields, etc. For expand WPA algorithm theoretical system and practical applications, according to the insufficiency of WPA, it is deeply investigated from theory aspect in this paper. On Theoretical Research on, for a wide range of typical algorithm for optimization, optimize, and improve internal operational mechanism of WCA algorithm to improve the WPA algorithm for single-objective optimization, multimodal optimization, and performance on multi-objective optimization problems.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of the Honeypot System Based on Spark
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The rapid development of the Internet services has made our life convenient but also attracted a lot of attacks. How to effectively protect the security of large Internet sites is a hot research. Here is the idea of design: When the user visits, the DNS server resolves the IP address and the user can get access to the fortress machine based on the analyzing results. Fortress machine captures the data with Iptables log function. Spark invokes the captured data to do real-time analysis and identify users of potential threats according to fixed rules. Then the fortress machine redirects the user based on the analysis results. If a user has threats, it will be redirected to the honeypot, otherwise it will be linked to the protected system.The experiments show that using big data technology to analyze log files can improve the speed of information processing and efficiency of system protection; The system can extend residence time of illegal visitors in the honeypot system with the same Website and achieves the purpose of collecting more illegal visitor’s information and facilitating future analysis.

articleTitle: Design of White Light LED Lighting Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional street lamps often use high pressure sodium lamp 360 degree light emitting. Because of the great loss, they cause great waste of energy. In the current environment of promoting clean energy development, higher demand for energy saving has been put forward. LED lamps, which can meet the demand of lighting and achieve energy saving effect at the same time,and can convert electric energy into light energy, and have the advantages of high conversion efficiency, green environment protection, long service life and low working voltage. Therefore, LED lights have been used more and more widely in all fields, especially in the lighting of families and public places.,,,, The design is based on AT89S52 microcontroller as the core of street lighting control system. The white LED lamps to replace the traditional light source, dimming with PWM white LED lighting simulation controller can effectively achieve the series of white LED lamp on and off, and can adjust the brightness level, and has a key lock function.

articleTitle: The Image Fusion of Compressive Sensing with Adaptive Deviation Feature
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive fusion rule combining high frequency feature of image is proposed.First,making a NSCT decomposition to the infrared image and visible light image, and after that to fuse them using regional energy criterion for the low-frequency sub-bands to obtain a better fusion result than the traditional low frequency coefficients. Next,Since the decomposed high-frequency sub-band coefficients have high sparsity,they are compressed by CS and adopted adaptive fusion rule according to the standard deviation feature.Finally, it gets fusion image by reconstruction of compressive sensing and inverse NSCT transform for data which has been fused. The experimental results show that this paper solves the shortcomings of the traditional image fusion algorithm based on the compressive sensing method (CS), which makes the final fusion image take into account the background information and infrared target information of the image to be fused, effectively improve the integration effect and subjective feelings.

articleTitle: Intelligent Greenhouse Clean Energy Control Integrating Multi-Granularity Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, we study the completeness of intelligent greenhouse clean energy control integrating with multi-granularity Internet of Things, and apply the weighting algorithm to the model output error indicators to replace the algorithm of Heinstein posterior probability formula. Combined with the theory, it is concluded that when the weights meet the convergence conditions, the intelligent greenhouse clean energy control system integrating the multi-granularity Internet of Things proposed in this paper has good completeness, which can be applied to the multiple linear model for approximation. Through the experiments it is concluded that the intelligent greenhouse clean energy control system integrating multi-grain Things of Internet has a good intelligence and very good completeness is, can get the control accuracy is higher.

articleTitle: The Establishment of Data Analysis Model about E-Commerce’s Behavior Based on Hadoop Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, Online shopping has been quickly favored by the vast number of consumers of all ages due to its convenience. But with online shopping business’s continuous growing, many companies are beginning to be faced with competitive pressure and slowed revenue growth.In the commercial competition, data analysis has become an effective mean to auxiliary operations.In this context, by building E-commerce data analysis platform Based on Hadoop, this model used the parallel computing capability of Hadoop platform to analyze and deal with E-commerce data. So as to give enterprises a clearer understanding of the customer's interest preferences,and then provide consumers with products or services which are more targeted and meet the actual needs of them better. Thus it will help promote products and enhance competitiveness in the new situation.The test results showed that this model could achieve E-commerce data processing, and analysis of consumers’ consume behavior.

articleTitle: Design of English Writing Assisted Instruction Teaching System Based on Intelligent Cloud Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligent level of English writing teaching system, a design method of intelligent English writing assisted instruction system is proposed based on cloud service platform, the overall design model of English writing teaching system is constructed, the Cloud-P2P fusion model is used in English writing teaching resources information fusion processing, in English writing teaching resources database client, spatial data is released, original data extraction and semantic features analysis are taken from any node of Web, English writing assisted instruction resource information are displayed on the client side, the method of segment fusion fuzzy clustering is used for correlation semantic fusion clustering processing, improve the English writing teaching resources information retrieval ability. The system can access to a Cloud-P2P based application system through the local client interface (or browser), the cloud computing technology and intelligent cloud service platform are used for software development of English writing auxiliary teaching system. The test results show that the English writing teaching system designed in this paper has good adaptability and learning ability, and the system reliability is better.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: teaching; computer aided instruction; Big Data; feature extraction; data mining; Internet; cloud computing; pattern clustering; fuzzy set theory; learning (artificial intelligence).

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Currently in China, most dangerous areas work manually or by hand. To this end, we have devised a set of vehicle robots for video image capture, image processing, image display, color detection, alarm and robot gripper. Through the algorithm of FPGA processing, the blue object is detected by the camera 1 to generate the PWM trigger signal to drive the motor to rotate, and the color of the object collected by the camera 1 is displayed in real time on the VGA transparent display 1 with the background of the screen, Alarm The detected objects in different positions in the VGA display 1 drive the trolley robot to perform different movements to move to different areas. Camera 2 as a global monitoring trolley robot, the global monitor video images displayed in real time on the VGA display 2, the staff can monitor 2 video surveillance in the field of view of camera 1 to move any one tiny blue object To control the car robot, the movement to the corresponding area location, you can also control the car robot's claw to carry out some dangerous goods crawling.

articleTitle: Computer-Based Test of Spoken English Translation Accuracy Evaluation System with Wireless Mobile Terminal
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of spoken English translation evaluation and artificial intelligence, the design of wireless mobile terminal test of spoken English translation accuracy evaluation system is researched. The system uses four layer construction design as wireless information collection layer, the mobile terminal information fusion layer, network data transmission layer, human computer interactive application layer. The original collection of computer-based spoken English translation information is taken based on host computer communication sensing information processing technology, Bus data transmission of English translation accuracy evaluation system is taken based on B/S structure, the test design process and remote scheduling information fusion are constructed based on LabWindows/CVI and B/S structure mining system, information data processing and cross compiler operation of the spoken English translation test evaluation system are completed in application layer, in the embedded kernel and on the wireless mobile terminal, the evaluation system is developed. The test results show that the integrated scheduling ability of spoken English translation test information system designed in this paper is better than traditional method, the cost time is less, and the control quality of the system is high.

articleTitle: A Semantic Text Similarity Model for Double Short Chinese Sequences
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Semantic Text Similarity plays a major role in natural language processing. In recent years, researchers have paid considerable attention to Semantic Text Similarity. Some breakthroughs have been made in English, but there are two disadvantages when these models are applied to Chinese: Single sequence models don't consider semantic ambiguity such as polysemy, synonym; these models don't consider that Chinese stop words are important for Chinese word segmentation, voice analysis, semantic understanding. Firstly, in order to overcome the first problem, we proposed the double short text sequences model that has two identical LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) processing two text sequences at the same time. Secondly, in order to overcome the second problem, according to the characteristics of Chinese, we used the Chinese semantic similarity data sets designed by experts to train and test the model, and retained the stop words in the model training process. Finally, the proposed model was compared with the Semantic Text Similarity model based on CNN (Convolution Neural Network) and the Baidu Semantic Text Similarity model. The results show that the model is greater than the previous two in terms of accuracy, recall rate and so on, and the generalization ability is improved also.

articleTitle: The Researches on the Development Strategy of E-Commerce and Logistics Based on Dynamic Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the development of e-commerce, great changes have taken place in commodity circulation model, the development of the huge logistics market has also made the logistics industry grow rapidly, but with the e-commerce business model changes and requirements increased, the bottleneck effect of logistics gradually emerged. In this paper, the dynamic evolution model is used to analyze the evolution direction of the influence factors, and then proposes to build an integrated information platform to achieve information exchange, and to strengthen the integration of the two sides to complete the integration of the overall system, and ultimately achieve the coordinated development of e-commerce and logistics.

articleTitle: Text Labeling Applied in Shopping Assistant Robot Using Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Shopping assistant robot plays a role as shopping guide in the supermarket. In this paper, we focus on early text labeling tasks which are crucial to design of robot conversation system and instruction selecting system. Part-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition are two fundamental tasks in nature language processing. In this paper, we need to implement both tasks in a robot by employing deep learning technics. The aim of this paper include: 1. Apply deep learning framework TensorFlow presented by Google to integrated robot development platform named Turtlebot2 which is provided by YUJIN ROBOT CO. 2. Construct text labeling model suitable for shopping assistant robot using a special recurrent neural network named long short-term memory.

articleTitle: Maturity Analysis of Citrus Based on Machine Vision and Android Mobile Platform Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Harvest maturity is an important factor affecting fruit storage quality. In order to realize rapidly and nondestructively discriminate to citrus maturity, the rapid and non-destructive testing of citrus maturity by using machine vision and Android mobile platform technology was studied in this paper. Firstly, the citrus images in the field were captured by the camera provided on the mobile phone. Secondly, the RGB values of the citrus color images were gray-scaled according to the ratio of 0.30: 0.59: 0.11. Thirdly, the images were segmented by the adaptive Ostu algorithm to get the binaryzation image. Fourthly, the binaryzation image was executed AND operation with the color source image to obtain a final image. Finally, the maturity formulas was used to separately calculate the percentage of pixels of the H and S components in the mature image of the citrus region to the whole citrus region in the final image. This process was implemented on the Android phone, through the 150 citrus image maturity analysis, the accuracy rate was attained to 90.7%. The test results showed that the method has good feasibility and can provide technical support for rapid and quantitative detection of citrus maturity.

articleTitle: Design and Application of College Students' Moral Education Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the real-time evaluation ability of college moral education teaching management, a model of College Students' moral education information management is proposed based on cloud computing information fusion scheduling. The development of College Students' moral education management system includes three parts as software development, database development and network development. The function module of the system mainly includes the college moral education teaching database module, program loading module, scheduling information module and data processing module, system network structure design takes C/S architecture to realize the optimization of information management and evaluation of college moral education teaching. The integrated software development and communication test are realized. The simulation results show that the system can realize the information management of college moral education teaching, the intelligent management of moral education is realized.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent International Law Online Consultation System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to popularize international laws, in this paper, we propose a design of intelligent international law online consultation system, which is implemented based on B/S architecture. In particularly, the proposed system is made up of User layer, Business logic layer, and Data layer. User layer provides users with the user interface through the browser. Business logic layer is designed to realize the function of the whole system layer, and it is located in the core layer of the Web server. The data layer contains a database server, logical processing and service system data. The proposed intelligent international law online consultation system is made up of four modules: 1) Legal information consultation, 2) Case analysis, 3) Online consultation, and 4) Information management. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system can handle solve the international law online consultation issue with low searching time and operation error rate.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Intelligent Economic Law Case Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: It is of great importance to accurately search economic law cases in database. In this paper, we propose a novel intelligent economic law case retrieval system. Information retrieval technology involves several aspects: such as database management, natural language processing, machine learning, and so on. Furthermore, basic technologies in information retrieval contain Web page downloading, document processing, and file indexing. The proposed intelligent economic law case retrieval algorithm is made up of four steps: 1) Feature extraction, 2) Feature integration, 3) Estimating weights for similarity computation, and 4) Economic law case matching. Particularly, particle swarm optimization is exploited to compute weights for similarity computation. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system is able to achieve high quality economic law case retrieval results.

articleTitle: Practical Ability Training on Visualization Teaching Design Based on Information Visualization Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous application of the information technology in the field of education, the ability of mankind to produce and acquire information has increased exponentially. How to carry out analysis on the massive information so as to support the in-depth learning of the students, as well as how to make use of the information technology to better present the teaching content and optimize the teaching process has become a problem that needs to be solved by the educational researchers. As a result, information mining and information visualization technologies have become hot topics that have attracted the attention of the scholars and experts. With the continual evolution of the information visualization technology, it gradually covers the scope of scientific visualization and information visualization, and includes part of the knowledge visualization contents. To carry out visualization processing on the information, it is necessary to go through the processes of acquisition, analysis, filtering, mining, expression, modification, interaction and so on; while taking the aesthetic presentation forms and the functional needs into consideration at the same time, to show the characteristics of visualization, association, artistry and interaction.

articleTitle: 64-Channel Data Acquisition Module Based on MLVDS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the demand for multi-channel and reliable high-speed data transmission of the test for environment of the rockets' launch .the article designed and developed a 64-channel data acquisition module based on MLVDS. With FPGA as the core, using VHDL to write logic control program to control data acquisition and reading process, add the CRC check arithmetic to improve the reliability, through MLVDS interface upload data to master communication module and the upper machine .The test results show that the data acquisition module is good, bit error rate is low and the transmission rate of up to reached 35 MB/S, satisfies the requirement of system design, and has been applied in rocket environment test system.

articleTitle: Research on Art Teaching Mode in the Environment of Information Technology and Curriculum Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: By analyzing the nature of teaching mode and the existing shortcomings in traditional art teaching, combining the characteristics of information technology and fine arts, this paper studies the shortcomings in the integration of information technology and subject in the past. On this basis, we put forward the teaching reform method of art course supported by information technology and try to build a new information technology and art course integration mode. Experiments show that when the feature dimension is low, compared with the traditional art teaching mode, the method in this paper improves the quality of teaching by 8%. At the same time, the performance of this method is also superior to other existing art education network teaching system methods.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Electric Power Marketing Strategy Based on the Big Data Dual Channel Marketing Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Electric power marketing is faced with a number of endogenous and exogenous risks while it is in full swing. And it has become the problem to be solved urgently to accurately identify these risk factors and their influences, so as to promote the smooth development of the electric power market. In this paper, the data related to 167 enterprises operating in the electric power market in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Qingdao and other cities are adopted. And the big data dual channel marketing model is used to analyze the risk factors of the electric power marketing. Studies show that the key risks that influence the electric power marketing include the network marketing risk, the cross-border electronic payment risk, the electronic customs clearance risk, the logistics risk and the credit risk; laws and regulations can have an indirect impact on the power marketing by influencing the online transactions, the customs clearance and other means.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Japanese Teaching Behavior Based on the Combination Membership Function
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper proposes a Japanese teaching behavior analysis algorithm which relies on the combination membership function. First, the teaching model of Japanese teaching is randomly distributed in a planar area as a point on the plane. Then, according to the clustering method of dependency membership function, clustering analysis is carried out from small to large population similarity coefficient. Finally, the recursive algorithm is used to collect the clustering results in the planar area, and the Japanese teaching groups with different teaching characteristics are obtained. The parallel strategy of the algorithm is also proposed, which improves the adaptability of the algorithm to large data volume. This paper takes the Japanese teaching behavior as the experimental data, and compares the result of the algorithm with the results of other classical clustering algorithms. The results show that the Japanese teaching behavior analysis algorithm can meet the requirements of Japanese teaching clustering and classification. Especially in the Japanese teaching analysis and one-on-one teaching analysis of the algorithm has intuitive, obvious characteristics of the characteristics of the category.

articleTitle: Data Mining Method and Empirical Research for Extension Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: For extension data mining of architecture design, the process and method to convert extension architectural design data to structural data with high quality are discussed in this article. In special knowledge mining of extension architectural design data, the problems of architectural space design, form design, extension knowledge mining for structural design are studied according to cross-industry standard process for data mining(CRISP-DM). They are integrated with operations of extenics, geometry, statistical theory to provide scientific and reasonable design. The results of case study show that our scheme can effectively convert extension architectural design data to computable structural data with unified format and high reliability.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of English Vocabulary Based on Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the automatic retrieval ability of English vocabulary, for the distribution of semantic attributes in English vocabulary, an automatic classification method of English vocabulary is proposed based on association rules, English vocabulary data storage model is constructed, a two element linguistic feature function is constructed for describing the directionality of English lexical retrieval scheduling, English vocabulary classification decision making model is constructed based on contextual relations of English vocabulary, the features of the association rules of English vocabulary are extracted, the adaptive learning method is used to realize the automatic classification of English vocabulary . The simulation results show that the method of English vocabulary classification has good performance, the classification error rate is low, the retrieval precision is high, and the computational overhead is small.

articleTitle: Design of English Teaching System for Human-Computer Dialogue Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligent level of English teaching, a design method of human-computer dialogue English teaching system is proposed based on cloud computing. The software development and design of the English teaching system and the design of hardware functional components are taken under the HP E1485A/B multi thread cloud platform, information fusion of English teaching resources is taken with cloud computing method, the development of multi thread software for man-machine dialogue English teaching is carried out by using UNIX class operating system, the design of the functional components is obtained considering design technical index and system performance of English teaching system, the system includes data acquisition module, cloud information fusion module, resource scheduling module, remote communication module and man-machine dialogue module. The integrated development of man-machine dialogue English teaching system is carried out in the embedded environment, and the optimization design of the system is realized. The simulation results show that the system has higher intelligence, it has better integration and stronger man-machine interaction.

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle Motion Control Based on Improved Immune Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Vehicle tracking control in intelligent driving cannot achieve accurate and rapid tracking effect by traditional control strategy for speed adjustment, so an immune PID controller for speed tracking control in automatic drive is designed. Through immune optimization algorithm and optimizing PID controller parameters, automatic adjustment of PID parameters can be realized to acquire the object of speed tracking. Simulation results show that immune PID controller in effective combination between immune optimization algorithm and PID controller can not only promote speed tracking to get strong adaptability and anti-interference ability but also provide effectively improve system stability. It improves steady and dynamic performance in system and shows perfect control effect.

articleTitle: A Wireless Pulse Rate Monitoring Terminal
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to reduce the size of the device and facilitate individuals to pay more attention to their own health, a wireless pulse rate monitoring terminal is proposed by utilizing IOT technology, sensor technology, wireless transmission technology and embedded technology. The specific scheme of the hardware and software design is given, and the operation results of the terminal are shown and analyzed. The terminal is successful in real-time monitoring of the pulse rate and body temperature at a certain wireless area?and the data can be displayed in the App client. Experiments results show that the monitoring terminal can get a complete and accurate pulse rate and body temperature, will have good application prospects in the prevention of elderly chronic diseases .

articleTitle: Study on the Training Method of Singing Language Based on Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper first analyzed the characteristics of the daily language and singing language, then analyzed the spectrum of the singing language, and studied the spectrum characteristic of singing language, at last, the spectrum analysis method was applied to the singing language training and improving, and it shows that the singing language training method based on spectrum analysis is helpful to improve the level of singing language.

articleTitle: Design of Wisdom Teaching Based on Network Learning Space
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Challenges and opportunities co-exist in the field of education in the 21st century. The intelligent and network learning space, the concept and technology of representing the times progress, leads the development of education. Unfortunately, the current college classroom teaching still remains at the level of knowledge and skill training, where students can master knowledge but lack of innovation ability. In the paper how to carry out the classroom teaching based on the theory of wisdom teaching is studied. With the application research of network learning space in universities, the paper summarizes the type of network space and defines the meaning of smart talent and wisdom teaching based on literature review and analysis. From the teaching practice and experience of many years, the paper analyzes the design of the relevant elements of the wisdom teaching, and expounds the operation arrangement of wisdom teaching. In conclusion university teaching should aim at cultivating intelligent talent, content organizatio9n should realize the transformation from knowledge to wisdom, and teaching organization should take into account the diversity, self-learning is the starting point of wisdom teaching, and should integrate problem solving and project innovation and flexibly arrange teaching in order to realize the target of high quality personnel training.

articleTitle: Study on Internal Control Mode of Accounting Information System under Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Under network environment, accounting information system is faced with both opportunities and challenges. How to improve safety of accounting information system has become the focus issue of the society. This paper, by studying relation between network environment and accounting information system and impact of network environment on accounting information system, puts forward that internal control measures should have a tendency of diversified development and proposes specific measures, to offer suggestions for perfection of internal control of accounting information system.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Fuzzy Outranking Approach for Group Decision-Making under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Portfolio selection is a hot topic in the research of smart Finance and Economics. In order to select the preferred stocks in a Portfolio, real-word decisions need to make to solve problems involve conflicting systems of criteria, uncertainty and imprecise information, especially those involve a group of decision makers (DMs) where a reduction of different individual preferences on a given set to a single collective preference, we consider a hybrid fuzzy Electre I approach for group decision-making under a fuzzy environment. The Electre method and its derivatives are prominent outranking approaches in Multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA), which is a widely used decision methodology that can improve the quality of group multiple criteria decisions by making the processes more explicit, rational and efficient. In this study, an alternative fuzzy outranking approach based on Electre I is proposed to consider the imprecise, uncertain, and linguistic assessments provided by a group of DMs. In this approach, the Electre I method is extended to take into account the uncertain, imprecise and linguistic assessments, besides, an outranking relation is defined by pairwise comparisons and the use of decision graphs to determine which action is preferable, incomparable or indifferent in the fuzzy environment. Feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are illustrated using a numerical example.

articleTitle: A Design on Tibetan-Chinese Online Translation System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Statics show that mastering the computer-aided translation software operating tools has been clearly required in their recruitment advertising for translators of 47.6% enterprises. It has been a trend to use computer-aided translation tools for all translators to enhance efficiency. However, there is still no accessible computer assisted translation system specially for Tibetan-English translation, the paper introduces a design for it from system model, key module and function application which hopes to apply more effective assistance for Tibetan-Chinese translators and promotes the communication and spreading of Tibetan-English information

articleTitle: Implementation of Blurred Pixel Inpainting Technology in the English Image
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: the accuracy of using traditional algorithm for the blurred pixels inpainting in the English image is not high. Therefore, a method of blurred pixel inpainting in English image based on curve evolution algorithm is proposed. The English image is made enhancement processing, and nonlinear transformation rule of English image curves is acquired through the operation. Using the discrete transformation method, it can achieve the blurred pixels inpainting in English image. The experimental results show that, using the algorithm to repair the blurred pixel English image, can improve the accuracy of inpainting, and achieve a satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Improved Schemes on Channel Interval for the Suppression of the Effect of Four-Wave-Mixing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the paper, two improved schemes are proposed to suppress the effect of four-wave-mixing (FWM) that the traditional wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) system in the formula of equal frequency interval would have. One such scheme is specified by a channel interval that is wider in the intermediate and narrower on the ends. The other is, however, a channel interval that is alternated each other unequally. The proposed schemes are realized and simulated by Optisystem11.0. Results show that, compared with the traditional counterparts, the two improved schemes are more effective in suppressing the effect of FWM, and moreover the latter scheme will perform better than the prior one.

articleTitle: Location Optimization Model of Logistics Distribution Center for Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper discusses the conception of agricultural supply chain and logistics center, and analyzes the influence of the development of agricultural supply chain management on function design and location of logistics center. Then it adopts mathematical models and methods in location and distribution method of logistics center to provide a system analysis, to establish a model with comprehensive consideration of transportation cost, fixed investment cost, management cost and loss cost of corroding agricultural products. To improve the diversity of colony and local search capability of enhancing the optimal solution in GA, we propose a genetic simulated annealing algorithm. The simulation results show the effectiveness and applicability of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: How Word-of-Mouth Influences Box-Office Revenues in China
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Electronic Word of Mouth (eWOM) has a great effect on consumers’ purchasing decision. Movies cannot be evaluated before consumption and that makes the eWOM much more important. The awareness and persuasive effect of the eWOM influence the box office revenues. The impact of the eWOM on revenues of movies’ box-office are investigated in domestic market of China. Using a sample of 224 movies released from 2015 and 2016, an OLS regression of this sample for eWOM was performed. This study concluded the Awareness Effect and the Persuasive Effect of the eWOM influencing the revenues of box office positively.

articleTitle: Research of Model Evolvement Method for Discrete-Event Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Incompleteness and dynamic changes of the system model cause more difficulty for the model based discrete event system diagnosis. Evolving the system model to the complete and true model in running time is one of the effective ways to solve this problem. Based on the actual observed events sequence obtained in system running time?a system model evolution algorithm is proposed according to the maximum matching degree defined here. The analysis results show that the proposed model evolution algorithm is effective and feasible, and it can be used as reference for the fault diagnosis of incomplete model. In addition, the definition of the maximum matching degree supports users to set different symbol matching weights, so in practical application, the system model evolution algorithm can adapt to different characteristics of the system.

articleTitle: Optical Network Management Data Integration and Fusion in Multi-Domain Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the optical network of different manufacturers and various equipment, according to the problem of heterogeneous and comprehensive application of network management big data, the differences of typical network management system is realized by using CORBA technology; with middleware technology, the big data integration and fusion of multi-source and multi-domain data is implemented; moreover, for the promotion of optical network maintenance and operation management capabilities, the application services of optical network big data is preliminarily explored.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis in Technology Problem Answering System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Considering the coming of the big data era, we are going to explore the auto-answering problem in technology's curriculum tests with big data. This kind of test contains the properties in Science and Math tests. In this paper, we describe an alternative approach that operates at three layers of representation and reasoning: information retrieval, corpus statistics, and simple inference over a semi-automatically constructed knowledge base. We evaluate the approach on ten years of exam problems from Wuhan University of Technology Fundamentals of Mono-Chip Computers Exams, and show that our overall system has the score of 62.2%. We apply the Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) thought in one of the methods, and get the improvement of 2.1% over the original methods. We try first for the problems of courses in Colleges and Universities, and leverage GANs in this Technology Problem Answering System.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Speaking English Exam System Based on C/S
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper analyzes current status of teachers' speaking test, applies presently mature C/S system structure and offers a network way for teachers' speaking exam. We provide the whole process of design and development in online speaking exam, illustrate several functional designs including item bank construction, auto-generating examination paper and test paper analysis and discuss various network programming development technology during teachers' speaking network examination intensively. Directed by software engineering theory, the system is finally designed and realized through feasible research, requirement analysis, general design, detailed design, and tests with popular system development language and powerful database management.

articleTitle: Approximate Repetitive Image Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Combining the semantic representation ability of deep learning and the discriminant ability of the significant image region, a deep representation method based on universal target detection technology is proposed. First, a general object detector is used to detect a small number of areas that are most likely to contain objects in the image. Then, the deep characterization is extracted in these areas. At the same time, in order to describe the local attributes in the region, the local invariant features are extracted and fused with the depth characterization. The fusion experiment shows that this method can achieve more abundant image characterization.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data in Home Residence Design Based on Family Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The thinking of the Internet has made indoor design develop rapidly as the era of big data. With the vigorous promotion of urbanization, the indoor environment of residential buildings has not been studied in detail. Based on the characteristics of different stages of family life cycle, the design of residential interior design solutions is presented. Most residential interior design has been able to meet the basic design requirements. However, with the development of social consumption patterns, individualized demand is obvious. The functional requirements of people in the interior of a residential space will inevitably change with the development of the times. The functional spatial layout of buildings has been unable to meet the different residential needs of different family life cycle stages. Therefore, based on the big data, and through the research methods of interior design, it is necessary to find a balance point between the invariance of the building and the variability of the demand for the residential space.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Image Hash Algorithm in Image Tamper Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the application of improved image hashing algorithm in image tampering detection, based on compressed sensing and ring segmentation, a new image hashing technique is studied. The image hash algorithm based on compressed sensing and ring segmentation is proposed. First, the algorithm preprocesses the input image. Then, the ring segment is used to extract the set of pixels in each ring region. These aggregate data are separately performed compressed sensing measurements. Finally, the hash value is constructed by calculating the inner product of the measurement vector and the random vector. The results show that the algorithm has good perceived robustness, uniqueness and security. Finally, the ROC curve is used to analyze the classification performance. The comparison of ROC curves shows that the performance of the proposed algorithm is better than FM-CS, GF-LVQ and RT-DCT.

articleTitle: Design of Biometric Recognition Software Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the biological characteristic analysis and recognition efficiency, biometric image analysis method is used for biological recognition, the design of biometric identification software is carried out to improve the dynamic recognition ability of biological images, a design method of biometric recognition software based on image processing is proposed. First of all, the infrared optical scanning technology is used to scan the biological images, and the edge contour features of the collected biological images are extracted. Texture feature information is extracted from biological images, the extracted biometric information is input into the embedded software system. In the design of biometric identification software, biological feature recognition software uses real time trigger PXI-6713 for biological image acquisition, software development is taken under the embedded Linux drive kernel, the software system of biometric identification is developed by using DSP and logic programmable PLC, and the optimization design of biometric software is completed. The test results show that the biometric identification system designed in this paper has a good ability to identify biological images, and the accuracy of biometric recognition is high.

articleTitle: Wireless Network Security Detection System Design Based on Client
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Paper first discusses the development and security safeguard mechanism of WLAN(Wireless Local Area Network).Then it introduces the technical standards of several types of security protocols in the development of WLAN,analyzes the security problems of several standards in application,and finally proposes a Phishing Wi-Fi detection scheme.

articleTitle: Exploration of Wisdom Design of Intelligent Packaging
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the changes in people's production and lifestyle by the development of science and technology, the traditional packaging is quietly changing. Under the premise of satisfying the basic functions of packaging, the intelligent packaging that fully embodies personalized consumer demand,highlighting humanistic care and expanding product functions is gradually emerging. This type of packaging is based on the integrated use of advanced design elements such as modern intelligent materials, intelligent technologies and intelligent structures to enhance the protection of packaging and to meet the special needs of consumers. Basedon the case study of Chinese and foreign intelligent packaging design, this paper elaborates the concept and characteristics of intelligent packaging design through the interpretation of intelligent packaging technology and principle, analyzes the representation of intelligent packaging design, and systematically explores the intelligent packaging design method.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of English Teaching Quality Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of English teaching quality evaluation, so as to promote the quality of English teaching, an evaluation method of English teaching quality is proposed based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, the index system model of English teaching quality evaluation is constructed, a decision tree model is used for construction of English teaching quality index model, objective function of English teaching quality evaluation is constructed based on fuzzy decision model, the conjugate function analysis method is used to optimize the decision function, the attributes that can reflect the quality of English Teaching is extracted, accurate evaluation and prediction of English teaching quality are realized. The simulation results show that the method of English teaching quality evaluation is reliable, it has high degree of confidence, evaluation result is accurate.

articleTitle: Transmission of Subcarrier Square Wave in Radio over Fiber Communication System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To avoid the disadvantages of Radio over Fiber (RoF) communication system in optical domain modulation, subcarrier modulation in electrical domain using Field- Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is proposed to generate baseband subcarrier square wave. Then the subcarrier signal is modulated to optical signal using optical fiber experimental box, which can be transmitted through optical fiber. The waveform of the original square wave can be observed on the oscilloscope after the transmission through the optical fiber system with good effect. The experimental results show that subcarrier modulation can be done in electrical domain, which prove the feasibility of subcarrier modulation in the electrical domain using FPGA, and providing another way of subcarrier modulation.

articleTitle: A Big-Data-Analysis-Based Research Study on the Changes Both in the Dependence on Foreign Trade and in the Trade Structure (2000-2015) of the Yunnan Province of China
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This research is based on the statistics database of the World Bank (data.worldbank.org.on), big data related to the monitoring of foreign trade, and relevant statistics data from China's statistics database. And big data analysis was applied to study the changes both in the dependence on foreign trade and in the trade structure of the Yunnan province of China. According to the research results, Yunnan's degree of dependence on foreign trade had increased from 7.46% in 2000 to 11.22% in 2015; however, such rate of increase is slower than the expectation based on Yunnan's growth rates of GDP and total foreign trade volume. From the data about the structure of dependence on import and export trade, we can see that Yunnan's dependence on export trade, though keeps fluctuating, had been growing slowly in a general view, and the fluctuant dependence on import trade had also been in a growing trend, though the growth is not obvious. In terms of foreign trade pattern, Yunnan's foreign trade mainly consists of general trade and small border trade. General trade have shared a higher proportion in and made more contribution to Yunnan's foreign trade, and the proportion of general trade in Yunnan's total value of import and export is growing in general, while the proportion of small border trades in the same is decreasing.

articleTitle: The Data Analysis about Management Holdings and Company Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Management holdings and company performance has always been the focus of academic research. Based on both domestic and international research, this paper studies the research object of NEEQ companies and takes 2015 NEEQ panel data as a sample, using multiple regression analysis to examine the relationship between the management holding ratio of the NEEQ companies and the performance of the company. The results show that there is a nonlinear relationship between the proportion of management holdings and the performance of the company in the NEEQ companies. In the NEEQ market, the correlation is positively correlated with the proportion of management shares (0% -18.96%), and there is a negative correlation when the proportion of management shares is between (18.96-100%). Its overall show inverted "U" type relationship. The study also found that: the concentration of stock equity is also conducive to the smooth implementation of the company for decision-making. In the NEEQ companies, there is a significant positive correlation between the largest shareholder of the shareholding ratio and corporate performance.
