articleTitle: Analysis of Parameter Selection for Permutation Entropy in Logistic Chaotic Series
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: the parameter selection problem of permutation entropy (PE) in Logistic chaotic time series is discussed in this paper. The length of window?embedding dimension and time delay- are the three factors influenced the PE , it is discussed the influence accused by only one factor through simulations, and results show that when the value of window length is bigger than some point, the different of PE value is not obvious, meanwhile embedding dimension during 3-5 and delay time equal to 3 or 5. Then, it is discussed that the combined selection of both embedding dimension and time delay, conclusion is that the PE curve can best reflects the changes of status for Logistic Chaotic Series.

articleTitle: PAC-MAN Game Based on SAPF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: PAC-MAN, I believe we are not unfamiliar. Suppose such a rule: the player - controlled elf eats all the beans hidden in the maze and can't be caught by the "ghost". Notice that, the “ghost” is running automatically, not manually controlled. Obviously, an efficient AI which is the core of game determines game's outcome. How to eat more beans in the shortest possible time, in other words, we should choose the shortest path to reach. Therefore, designing an efficient pathfinding algorithm is the key.

articleTitle: Research on Real Time Online Detection System for High Temperature Ceramic Tile Color
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the existing technology under the background of tile detection technology is basically the cooled ceramic tile to send to each detection area by artificial or artificial machine were strict testing, resulting in automatic tile detection of low intensity, production processes, high labor intensity of workers, manufacturers in high cost, low detection efficiency, the problem of unstable system so, this paper proposes an accurate, efficient, real-time, automatic detection system of high temperature ceramic tile stable operation and convenient maintenance. The use of FPGA parallel data processing advantages, the combination algorithm of color data obtained high temperature tile and stored in a database for statistical analysis to the test data and the database for the calibration data of VS2015 by using software the development and application of platform to realize the man-machine interface. The ceramic tile production complex takes about 380 steps, and the system calibration data in the database by calling the High temperature of tile detection judgment, if the decision failed can directly eliminate the production line, not to continue the process of follow-up testing, greatly reducing the production and testing process of ceramic tile. The experiment proved that the system can be in the range of allowable error of high temperature ceramic tile is accurate, real-time online detection efficiency.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Agent Negotiation Model for E-Commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the study of agent conception, multi-system architecture and communication language, this article establishes a novel negotiation model for intelligent e-commerce, according to the agent negotiation process in e-commerce platform. It focuses on the key technical problems supporting automatic negotiation, that is, knowledge sharing and negotiation strategy for negotiation content. Then a negotiation strategy based on GA is proposed which introduces GA to study the opponent's preference and utility function, to achieve win-win result of client and supplier under the condition of incomplete information. Finally the multi-agent negotiation model is simulated and analyzed on simulation platform to verify the correctness and feasibility of this model.

articleTitle: An Analysis of College Students' Deep Entrepreneurship Patterns Based on Spatio-Temporal Big Data Flow
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Students' complicated behaviors often lead to fluctuations in the status of the job market and destroys the stable operation of the job market. This paper introduces the theory of spatio-temporal big data flow, constructs an adaptive student entrepreneurial behavior evaluation method for the status of job market, uses association rules reduction and association rules importance degree method to excavate the data of college students' entrepreneurial behaviors and job market status, analyzes the association degree of college students' entrepreneurial behaviors on job market status changes so to adaptively build the evaluation indicator and weight and accurately quantify the influence degree of students' entrepreneurial behaviors on job market status changes. The experimental results show that the evaluation method can help to accurately find out the students who caused the job market status changes and their behaviors, and effectively support the management and control of students' entrepreneurial behaviors.

articleTitle: Application Study on Data Mining Technology of English Learning Virtual Community
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper puts forward a novel multi-dimensional foreign language learning community. Different form traditional virtual learning community, it evaluates, classifies through real-time and dynamic students’ learning status and automatically introduces students to operate group-learning in different abilities levels of learning community. During the process of design and realization of students’ evaluation classification, this article adopts students’ learning process data from ontology technology-based multi-mode interactive network learning environment to generate cognitive diagnosis model which accurately reflects students’ learning status. With comprehensive analysis consideration, we choose reasonable and effective clustering algorithm, implement cluster analysis in model and realizes data mining application of system in E-learning environment successfully.

articleTitle: Professional Construction of Counselors in Network Times for Sparse Big Data Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the Internet age, when evaluating the results of the professional construction of the counselor, it is usually assumed that a professional construction item contains multiple subtopic-aware of professional construction with different weights, and on the basis of this assumption, the results of the professional construction are evaluated. Although most of the existing counselor professional evaluation methods have used these characteristics to evaluate the results of the professional construction, they have neglected the types of the professional construction subtopic-aware in the evaluation process. Firstly, this feature is described in this paper by introducing the sparse big data equilibrium, and the classification method of the subtopic-aware of the professional construction is abstracted: and then puts forward the framework that evaluates the results of the professional construction of the counselors by constructing subtopic-aware type information for the sparse big data equilibrium, which defines the structure that it should have the evaluation of the professional construction of the counselor by using the professional construction subtopic-aware type information: Then, on the premise that taking information class and the navigation class as the subtopic-aware classification method, its corresponding sparse big data equilibrium form is discussed: finally, the experimental results on TREC and NTCI R test sets show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on English Pronunciation Recognition Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: English pronunciation recognition model based on neural network is proposed in this paper, which can effectively detect English pronunciation and improve English listening teaching effect. Signal detection and processing of English pronunciation and speech signals are carried out to extract the associated features of English pronunciation and speech signals, the concatenated filtering method is used to process the speech signal of English pronunciation. Time frequency analysis is used to convert English pronunciation signals from time domain to frequency domain to detect and recognize English pronunciation signals, the extracted English speech signal features are input into the neural network classifier to realize the English pronunciation recognition. Simulation results show that the proposed method has high accuracy and strong anti-interference ability, and it has practical value in guiding English listening teaching.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Marketing Optimization of Economy Hotel Online Group-Buying Based on Priority Queuing System Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In online group-buying market of economy hotel, many economy hotels to optimize their own marketing channels through online group buying. This paper presents the marketing channel optimization method of economy Hotel (MCOMEH). This method guarantees the multi-channel marketing optimization of economy hotel online group-buying under the constraint of local operating priority queuing. The experimental results show that MCOMEH based on the priority queuing system model can not only ensure that the customer's work is not affected, but also that the coordination between various economy hotels can be improved on such basis. The target value of the obtained solution sets of marketing channel optimization not only is superior to the existing synergy evolution method generating intersection sets, but also has a good dispersity of solutions.

articleTitle: Research on Separation Algorithm for Space-Based AIS Signal Collision
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Blind source separation technology is introduced to solve the problem of signal collision which is caused by the multiple signals arrived at satellite receiver simultaneously. This technology uses FastICA algorithm to separate the signals once it detects the collision, while FastICA also exists the problem of slow convergence due to too much iterations. This paper therefore proposed an improved FastCIA to overcome its shortcoming of complicated iterations. The simulation results prove that the proposed algorithm can achieve the faster convergence with the same effectiveness comparing with the original algorithm.

articleTitle: The Comparison of Several Kinds of Permutation Entropy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Permutation entropy is widely used in medical, biological, mechanical, image processing and other fields, especially fault diagnosis. The permutation entropy (PE) is used to evaluate the complexity and randomicity of the time series. The multiscale permutation entropy (MPE) is an improvement method of PE and is often used to evaluate the time series of physiological systems and mechanical systems. Both of them have the advantages of simplicity, noise robustness and low computational complexity. A modified multiscale permutation entropy (MMPE) that the mean value is replaced by the median value is proposed in this paper. The PE, MPE and MMPE of different signals are compared. Simulation results show that MMPE is more stable than MPE for the high-frequency signal.

articleTitle: The Spatial Constraint Distribution Method of Sports Industry Integrating the Structure Cluster of Intelligent Sports Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Due to the lack of unified planning for the sports industry, the space layout is not reasonable. In this paper, a single sports industry area is used as a benchmark to extend it to a number of sports industry areas. The intelligent sports industry cluster is adopted to update the sports industry spatial constraint distribution in real time, and rationally constrain the spatial constraint distribution of sports industry actually participating in the planning, and then confirm the planning plan through real-time statistics. Finally, the feasibility and rationality of the method are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Foreign Student Party Construction Model for the Sparse Large Data Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a foreign student party construction mode (shorted as FSPCM) for sparse large data equilibrium. In FSPCM, we construct sparse large data based on category tag variables, which not only enables the classifier to conduct the foreign student party construction, which makes the effect of the foreign student party construction of each classifier can be greatly enhanced, and the correlation between the marker classifier and the sparse large data can be established by the foreign student party construction, so that the correlation of the sparse large data obtained by the foreign student party construction is more accurate. Through the use of two different loss functions, logistic regression and least squares. The FSPCM-LR (FSPCM with logistic regression) algorithm and the FSPCM-LS (FSPCM with least squares) algorithm are proposed and extended into the regenerated nuclear Hilbert space. Finally, through the alternation solution, we can get FSPCM-LR and FSPCM-LS, compare with 20 reference data sets, and use five different evaluation criteria. Finally, the results show that FSPCM is better than the proposed sparse large data algorithm.

articleTitle: A Circular Region of Interest Image Retrieval Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid rise of mobile Internet and smart mobile terminals, content-based image retrieval applications are becoming more and more widespread. The realization of search applications such as books, flowers and vegetables, and LOGO has also become one of the key technologies in Smart City. In this paper, a novel image retrieval method for region of interest(ROI) is proposed. Firstly, interest points of image are extracted according to Harris algorithm, a circular region of interest is obtained by screening interest points; then, extract the various features of the ROI. Finally using distance function to measure the similarity degree between images. Experiments show that the proposed method can effectively extract the region of interest, and achieve better retrieval performance.

articleTitle: A Cross-Application Energy Saving Mechanism For Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Wireless sensor network node is resource-constrained and difficult to replace its power. How to reduce energy consumption effectively is the practical problem. Existing literatures most aims at the single application to design scheme and performance evaluation protocols. Since the single node executes more than one application, it is a new challenge to make an optimal energy control based on cross-application. The paper proposes a cross-application energy saving mechanism for Wireless Sensor Networks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet of Things Interactive System Based on sEMG
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the features of the surface electromyography (sEMG), and the internet technology, we developed a kind of internet of things interactive system, which can provide a more natural and relaxed interactive experience, such as wireless control, rehabilitation, entertainment and other fields. This article briefly introduces the consistence of system including hardware and software, the algorithm of picking signal characteristics and an experiment was carried out to control an intelligent device.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for EWTC System Based on Segmentation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Electronic Weight Toll Collection (EWTC) pattern for truck is an effective way to solve congestion in highway toll station. However, due to the limitation of model, there is no ideal method to accurately measure the weight of dynamic vehicle. Aimed at above problems, an optimization method for EWTC system based on segmentation algorithm is proposed, which is based on Euler Bernoulli pavement interaction model and adopts piezoelectric quartz sensor. A 4-row in-line dynamic weighing system is built in the form of sensor sparse array. The measure test was carried out on the optimized system in Harbin east roll station of Harbin–Tongjiang. The results bespeak that the accuracy is ±2% with the 95% confidence interval and the strong robustness of the system are able to cope with all kinds of rule-breaking operations. The system can effectively improve the traffic capacity of toll stations, reduce queuing time of vehicles and provide a new method for the overload treatment of highway.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Human Brain and Electromagnetic Radiation SAR Based on HFSS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the development of wireless communication technology, the transmission efficiency is increasing while the electromagnetic radiation is increased. The harm of electromagnetic radiation to human body has been a research hot. In order to measure the radiation for the human brain from electromagnetic radiation when using the hand-held mobile terminal, a new measurement method is proposed that design and simulate the model made of hand-held mobile terminal and human brain with HFSS software, then record some parameters from SAR(specific absorption rate) curve, electric field intensity distribution and magnetic field intensity distribution after simulation. The simulation results show that the parameters of electromagnetic radiation SAR are much higher than international standards when the human brain and hand-held mobile terminals are paste to each other but when the distance increases gradually it appears the nonlinear decreasing trend.

articleTitle: A Precise Press-Fit System of Booster Valve Based on Real-Time Displacement Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to increase the efficiency and accuracy of automotive components press-fit in assembly lines, a precise press-fit system of booster valve is proposed based on real-time displacement monitoring. Firstly, the working principle of the booster valve is introduced. Then, after analysis of the design requirements of press-fit monitoring system, the mechanical structure and design principle of the control system are elaborated. On the basis of software and hardware design, real-time monitoring and control of the displacement and the pressure during press-fit process are realized by adopting the control method of A/D conversion and D/A conversion combined with high-speed voltage comparator. As a result, the press-fit efficiency and accuracy have been greatly increased and the electromagnetic performance of the booster valve can be guaranteed.

articleTitle: Research on Centralized Dispatching System of Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The paper introduces the development trend of urban rail transit network in China and the system related to the operation and dispatching of the network command center, analyzes the drawbacks of the existing network dispatching system, puts forward the concept and system scheme of the urban rail transit's centralized dispatching system, summarizes the improvements brought to the rail transit operation, and in-depth elaborates IP, SIP, dispatching strategy and other key technologies.

articleTitle: Machining Parameter Optimization and Simulation Machining of Five Axis NC Machine Tool Impeller
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The impeller has complex shape parts automatic programming of five axis NC machine, parameter optimization and simulation processing,complete the automatic programming of NC program,and preparation process, which plays an important role in the process of impeller. In the processing of five axis machine blade section, the blade root is composed of datum plane positioning and clamping tip with thimble hole processing tight manner, simple, reliable positioning, but relatively difficult to detect the top pinhole position of datum, so usually top pin relative to the reference surface will appear in the offset processing the blade type line must be 3D compensation.

articleTitle: Research on Event Operation Risk Evaluation and Coping Strategies of Wushu Sanda Games
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Under the background of perfect market economy the commercial events of Wushu Sanda games should be fully combined with market-oriented operation mode and means, to establish healthy and interactive operation system for comprehensive society benefit. Risk management is very necessary for Wushu Sanda games, and risk evaluation is the premise of risk management. Using fuzzy analytical hierarchy process(FAHP), this article recognizes the game risk factors and assign weight to each risk factor, described by fuzzy judgement matrix. Then each risk factor is quantified and sorted with FAHP for organizers to deal with the major risks before and after the games. The test results indicate that the implementation of FAHP in Wushu Sanda games increase the operability of risk evaluation, and it also shows good feasibility and applicability to evaluate large-scale sports events risk.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Campus Mobile Office Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile internet, The campus life is deeply changing. Campus Mobile Office Platform can make the teachers' and students' campus life more facilitate. The main functions of the platform are campus bulletin, teaching arrangement, course inquiry, examination arrangements, student achievement, attendance information, leave applications, e-mail, online learning, library, campus positioning, network repair, part-time information, second-hand information. This paper studies the basic functions and the key problems of platform development, then gave the solution for the key problems.

Author Keywords: the solution for the key problems

articleTitle: Transmit Antenna Selection in a Massive MIMO System Using Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Massive MIMO systems, where the base station are equipped with a large number of antennas and simultaneously serving multiple single-antenna users, can offer more system capacities than conventional MIMO. Due to system complexity and hardware cost, it is necessary to select transmit antennas in order to reduce the number of RF chains. Convex optimization is used to select the antenna subset in order to maximize total receive power of all users, then the precoding method based on maximal signal-to-leakage-plus-noise-ratio(SLNR) is used to with selected antennas. The simulation results shows the proposed method of antenna selection can significantly improve the system BER performance, and is very feasible in practice.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Telecom User Business Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Now in the process of operation of telecommunication system, telecom user business management as the main part of the system management part, main is to guide the telecom operators how to manage the telecommunication billing system, become an integral part of telecom billing system. In this paper, the design process in combination with the current market competition and telecoms industry mainly aimed at party B's business requirements, and closely combined with the current in the process of actual operation of some of the more advanced technology domestic and overseas, the design is based on JAVA B/S mode of telecom business management system.

articleTitle: A Dual Band Semi-Passive Sensor Tag Based on the Technique of Electromagnetic Field Scavenging
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The study provides a dual band semi-passive sensor tag with one band used for delivering the information of interest, the other one for aggregating the power necessary for sensor head offset. The proposed sensor tag is a planar structure equipped with two radiators. The radiator1 is a planar inverse F-type metallic strip connected to RF/DC rectifier and grounding plane via, respectively, the feed and the short line. The radiator2 is an inverse L-type metallic strip connected to grounding plane directly. A RF/DC rectifier is set between the feed and the grounding plane, the offset output from which is exerted to the electrode of the sensor head fabricated by interdigited fingers with resistive load. The radiator1, the short line, the feed and the grounding plane form the first RF channel for delivering the information of interest; the radiator2, the sensor head, the feed and the RFin port in the RF/DC rectifier form the second channel for power scavenging and transmitting; while the RF/DC rectifier, the feed, the sensor head, the radiator2 and the grounding plane form the circuit of offset yielded and applied to the electrodes of the sensor head.

articleTitle: Reform of Teaching Method Based on Wisdom Education in Communication Theory Curriculum
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Wisdom Education leads the development of education. Unfortunately, the current college classroom teaching still remains at the level of knowledge and skill training, where students can master knowledge but lack of innovation ability. With “communication theory” as an example, the application of wisdom Education is explored. The practice results indicate that this method can give full play to the initiative of students and stimulate students’ potential. In conclusion university teaching should aim at cultivating intelligent talent, content organization should realize the transformation from knowledge to wisdom, and teaching organization should take into account the diversity, self-learning is the starting point of wisdom teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Routing Algorithm Based on Dynamic Segmentation Network Coding
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of existing routing algorithms, an efficient routing algorithm based on dynamic segmentation network coding (ERBNC) is proposed. By compressing the header of the encoded packet, deleting the redundant ACK packet and setting the priority of sending the encoded packet, the proposed algorithm reduces the network overhead and packet average end-to-end delay. The simulation experiments of ERBNC algorithm, dynamic segmented network coding (DSNC) algorithm and segmented network coding (SNC) algorithm were completed by using OPNET simulation software. The performance of various algorithms is compared and analyzed. The simulation results show that the ERBNC algorithm can effectively reduce the network overhead and reduce the average end-to-end delay of data packets.

articleTitle: Research on Convenient Interior Design Method Based on Big Data Information Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In interior design, the application of information models is currently in its infancy. Based on the interior design process and information model technology theory, the concept of interior information modeling (IIM) is proposed. By analyzing the construction ideas, principles and processes of indoor information model, the construction method of indoor information model is put forward. Combined with the theoretical discussion, the project practice of the specific construction method of indoor information model is carried out. Through practice, the theory of indoor information model is verified and perfected. The general methods and specific methods of building indoor information model are summarized. The results show that the use of information technology to achieve computer-aided interior design is feasible. Big data, Internet of things and cloud technology will have an impact on the traditional interior space design. The key part of the interior design intelligence model is the definition and construction of the interior information model at the design stage.

articleTitle: A Research of Design on Wisdom Guide System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The integrated application of new generation information technologies such as Internet of Things, cloud computing, mobile internet and artificial intelligence has provided a new impetus for the development of a smart community. Guided Vision System is one of the core systems of a smart community. It provides users with location, direction and flow through various designs to support people's effective actions and make people's lives more convenient and better. This article first introduces the functional requirements of the smart community and the status quo and pain points of the development of the community guide system. Then, it focuses on how to realize the intelligent guidance system based on the wisdom technology and explores the technology to realize these functions. It is hoped that it can provide certain reference for the design and development of the wisdom guidance system in the future.

articleTitle: Construction and Testing of Modern Distance Learning Platform System Based on Struts and Hibernate Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to integrate the existing teaching resources, distance learning platform is designed and developed. In this study, Struts and Hibernate architecture is introduced, three-tier architecture is selected. At the same time, the role of Struts and Hibernate in the design is introduced. Distance learning platform includes online learning module, teaching resources module, online exams module, test questions download module, online discussion module, and online Q & A module. It has good security and interactivity. The system can effectively assist the teacher's teaching work. The development results show that each layer of this structure can focus on specific roles and functions and cooperate with each other. B / S mode has been applied to the network teaching platform, and users can achieve online teaching through the browser.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Management Information System for Frontier Defence Government Affairs
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: By theoretical design and practical making, this paper analyzes and studies frontier defence government affair system. It discusses the designing idea in the system, as well as establishment of database structure, main modules establishment in application program, difficulties and solutions in development and performance test of Military Intranet. In test results, the operation effect in system is obvious and the generated program interface can effectively satisfy army requirement with fast retrieval, convenient search, high reliability, large storage, good security and high information utilization. The system greatly improves the efficiency of personnel management, optimizes manpower and materials resources and provides personnel affair in army with assistance.

articleTitle: Site Selection and Optimization Based on GIS for Old People's Homes in Urban Area of Kunming City
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With aging of population and increasing of aged population of Kunming City, to meet the increasing endowment service needs of old people, government encourages social forces to construct endowment service institutions for old people, which definitely involves with site selection problems of old people's homes. This paper employs AHP methodology to analyze and determine the weight of impact factors of site selection for old people's homes in Kunming City and carries out spatial analysis on the impact factors based on GIS to clearly and visually solve the problems of site selection and optimization for old people's homes in Kunming City.

articleTitle: Diversity-DoF Tradeoff in Two-Cell Interfering Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Interference alignment (IA) has been shown to achieve the maximum achievable degrees of freedom (DoF) in interference networks. However, in a real wireless network, the SNR of links between base stations and users is finite. Hence, pursuing DoF is not the optimal scheme. In this paper, based on IA algorithms, tradeoff between DoF and diversity is analyzed in interference networks, where several approaches is fabricated which have different DoF and diversity order. Furthermore, simulation results are also provided, where we can conclude that different modes should be adopted when the users are in different environments.

articleTitle: Foreign Language Online Course Evaluation System Based on FCE
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: During the process to construct online lesson evaluation system of foreign language, we analyze the rationalization and quantitative processing of the foreign language online teaching. According to the actual situation, the questionnaire investigation of index screening for experts and students are performed and corresponding index system for teacher evaluation is determined. Then, the hierarchical structure model is established. AHP is adopted to construct the structure of judgement matrix and GA is used to compute the index weight of judgement matrix. The computing results pass the consistency test and the final data indicate the index weight proposed in this paper has approving consistency, which causes more accurate weights.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data Technology and Method in Moral Education in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the growth of science and technology and the progress of scientific and technological means, we have entered a new era of "big data", which influences and quietly changes our lives. In this new era, combined with the characteristics of their own and effective application of the technology and methods of big data, moral education in colleges and universities should seek favorable opportunities in a timely manner, and progressively realize the integration of digital technology and humanistic spirit, the complementary integration of network education and real education, the complementary integration of data thinking and traditional experience, and the complementary integration of situational awareness and ubiquitous education. In doing so, the effective development of moral education in colleges and universities can be improved constantly.

articleTitle: Analysis of Network Political Information Transmission Dynamics for College Students' Social Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: For the social network of college students in the political information dissemination is not comprehensive and not objective phenomenon. In order to make up for this defect, In this paper, a network political information transmission dynamics analysis method for college students' social network is presented. The dynamic analysis method is introduced into the communication of political information of college students to realize the regional transmission of political information. This method is more efficient and easy to operate, the realization of the political information on college students' social network expansion operation of effective communication, but also for political information transmission on the network unit volume can be achieved through the dynamic analysis. The experiment shows that: Compared with previous algorithms, the proposed method is better in performance and its expansibility is more prominent.

articleTitle: Multi-Column Convolution Neural Network Model Based on Adaptive Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A multi column convolution neural network model is constructed by using the idea of adaptive enhancement. It is applied to the practical application of traffic signs recognition. The data are preprocessed and the convolution neural network is trained. The high performance recognition of traffic signs is realized by the convolution neural network. The experiment proves that the convolution neural network is applied to the recognition of handwritten numerals and the identification of traffic signs.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Analysis Method of Ideological and Political Instructors' Work Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The information of Ideological and political instructors' work quantitative evaluation is a set of statistical feature data, in order to improve the ability of quantitative evaluation of Ideological and political instructors, a quantitative analysis method of Ideological and political instructors' work is proposed based on data mining, high dimensional phase space reconstruction method is used for feature data reorganization of political instructors' work in quantitative evaluation. In the reconstruction phase space, fuzzy clustering method is used to classify feature processing quantitative evaluation data. The association rules features of Ideological and political counselors' quantitative evaluation are mined, the adaptive learning algorithm is used for convergence process control, and accurate quantitative analysis of political instructors' work is obtained. The simulation results show that the method can analyze the political instructors' work accurately, and it has high degree of confidence, and improve the ideological and political education quantitative evaluation ability of counselors.

articleTitle: Research on Key Combination Management System Based on Identity Authentication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems in the current authentication system, a new authentication system scheme is proposed. The user identity is used as a key production factor by using the CPK (Combined Public Key) combination public key system. From the perspective of security design, and combining the theory of CPK combined public key system, the overall design framework of CPK key management system is proposed. According to the functional requirements of the system, the main modules of the system are divided, and its main functions are stipulated. The system uses a secure authentication card as the only identity of the user. The authentication card has a certain computing power and safe storage space. It realizes the secure storage of the user's key. Finally, from the actual application scenario, the data flow of the user in the process of registration and use in the system is given. The main modules of the system are tested successfully through the security authentication card.

articleTitle: The Practical Study of ESP Theory in Professional Foreign Language Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of economic globalization, foreign language talents who are cultivated by general foreign language teaching should meet the requirements of the international development strategy. Therefore, it is of great importance to promote foreign language teaching quality. In this paper, we discuss how to fully utilize the English for Specific Purposes (ESP) theory to enhance professional foreign language teaching quality. ESP refers to a type of teaching concept or approach as the counterpart of English for General Purposes (EGP), which contains a vast range of aspects. Particularly, we propose two English course design methods based on the ESP theory, that is, 1) language centered curriculum design, and 2) learning centered curriculum design. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can significantly improve teaching quality.

articleTitle: Hot News Mining Method Based on Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Internet news has been an important source of public access to information, it is of great importance to find useful information behind hot news. Therefore, in this paper, we aim to mine hot news using intelligent computing. Firstly, we proposed a framework of the hot news mining system, in which the comment evolution, area evolution, strength evolution are obtained based on topic extraction matrix and content evolution matrix. Secondly, we propose a novel hot news mining method based on Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), which is a three-level hierarchical Bayesian model. In the LDA model, each element of a collection is represented as a finite mixture for underlying topics. Finally, we construct two datasets using Sina Weibo and Twitter, and experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Motion Controller for Indoor Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The design of motion controller for indoor robot is based on a complex combination of software, hardware and machinery. The hardware includes single chip module, power module, motor drive module, servo module, speed detection module; software includes single chip initialization procedures, using the PID control algorithm to control the speed, by changing the duty ratio of PWM motor control, the use of camera for image acquisition module and other aspects, in addition, for a complete controller, mechanical improvement and innovation is the essential content

articleTitle: Cultivation of College Students' Entrepreneurial Decision-Making Ability in the Context of Supply Side Reform Integrating EMER Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of college students' entrepreneurial psychological capital intervention model is established from the perspective of psychological capital intervention model for the cultivation of the college students' entrepreneurial decision-making ability by exploring and analyzing the entrepreneurial problems related to the college students. A preliminary understanding of the entrepreneurial orientation of the college students is obtained by investigating the college students of different gender. The investigation results show that three factors, that is, the job selection and entrepreneurial location of the college students, the matching of career and profession, and the family relations, show the positive correlation. The research results show that: The entrepreneurial location, the matching of career and profession and the family relations are closely related to the choice of college students for the entrepreneurship. At the same time, the effects of economic, political sense and others in the entrepreneurial choice of the college students are explored separately. Therefore, the psychological capital intervention research on the psychological capital intervention model for the cultivation of the entrepreneurial decision-making ability of college students is carried out.

Author Keywords: In the Context of Supply Side Reform
College Students’ Entrepreneurial Decision making Ability

articleTitle: Research on Color Correction Based on CMOS Image Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Image color correction is an important part of digital image processing. Based on CMOS imaging theory and chromaticity theory, a complete video processing flow for digital microscope is proposed. It mainly includes linearization, color correction and white balance. BP neural network is a neural network model with three or more layers. It has a strong non-linear mapping capability. The advantage of using BP neural network for color correction is that the accuracy is good. It has great advantages, especially when the linear relationship between the two ends of the calibration process is not good. However, the computation is relatively large, which is suitable for the color correction of a single image. It cannot meet the real-time requirements when used on a video.

articleTitle: The Impact of Computer Information Management on Work Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The development of information technology has increased the rate of information expansion, making all kinds of information filled with people's lives. With the effective management of the work, these data information can achieve the comprehensive utilization of data information. With the support of these available data and information, we can improve the efficiency and quality of related work. Therefore, the article starts with the research of computer information management, analyzes the influence of computer information management on work efficiency, and clarifies the connection between the two. It aims to give full play to the functions of computer information management and promote the significant improvement of work efficiency.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of Electric Appliances Based on Sleep Perception
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, the algorithm of intelligent control electrical appliances is realized by studying the sleep state of people. Firstly, setting up the sampling frequency of image and getting the area of human eye according to the geometric feature of human face. Secondly, combining the mean with the characteristics of the human eye as the new feature to the grayscale histogram of the human eye region, the judgment of sleep state and the switch control of electrical appliances are realized by analysing eye condition. The method is simple and fast, and can adapt to different luminance environment. The experiment shows this algorithm can quickly determine the state of human body and make correct instructions, those work can provide some necessary preconditions for subsequent application and optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis of Eutrophic Trend and Driving Factors for Fuxianhu Lake in Yunnan Province
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Research and analyze the eutrophic trend and driving factors of Fuxianhu Lake during 2005 to 2013 using principal component analysis method based on factor analysis. Results showed that Fuxianhu Lake's water quality was in class I,but it was disturbed easily by environment conditions. Its eutrophic state was increased continually, and it showed the trend of decreasing from north and south bank to the centre of the lake. Four principal components,including the eutrophication index,object feature index, pH index and organic index were extracted from the water quality parameters of Fuxianhu Lake by the method of the PCA and factor analysis. Phosphorus nutrient, WT, pH and CODMn were the main driving factors for the principal components. All principal components had the different distribution trends in every direction for Fuxianhu Lake, and F1 represented most of the information. So we should strengthen the control of phosphorus nutrient for the Fuxianhu Lake's protection.

articleTitle: University Ideological Education Quality Assessment Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: How to improve ideological teaching quality to enhance the competitiveness of the university has become the important subject of each university. In this paper, through the study of the characteristics of teacher quality, teaching evaluation and the main factors influencing the teaching evaluation, on the basis of analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of the existing teaching evaluation system, we formulate a set of feasible evaluation index system for ideological teaching. Then, we use the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to calculate the evaluation data, which ensures that the results of evaluation is scientific and accurate. The struts 2, JSP, and Hibernate technology is used to develop a kind of online teaching evaluation system based on B/S structure. The experiment results show that the designed system has good stability.

articleTitle: A Queue Theory-Based Approach to Software Reliability Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Measuring reliability refers to quantifying the reliability of a component or system by quantitative metrics. Software reliability growth models have been proposed to estimate and predict the reliability growth of software. Most conventional Software reliability growth models take the faults detected may be corrected immediately into consideration. In reality, this case may not be reasonable and may not be always occur, as there is often a considerable time delay between identify the root causes of faults detected and then correct them. Besides, experiments show that detection effort, correction effort, and the match of detection effort and correction effort have the great effect on time delay. In this paper, we use finite server queuing models to investigate software debugging processes. We will propose finite server queuing models with various distribution function and change-point under perfect and imperfect debugging environments. An actual software failure data set is analyzed to illustrate the effectiveness of proposed models. Experimental results show that the proposed models have a fairly accurate predication capability.
